title: Information Assurance Analyst - Cleared
description:
RDTS is seeking Cleared Senior to Mid-level Information Assurance Analysts to support the Bureau of Overseas Building Operations (OBO) at the U.S. Dept of State in Washington, D.C. We are seeking a highly experienced and policy-savvy Information Assurance Analysts to lead information assurance activities supporting the OBO. This senior role provides expert-level support for governance, risk management, compliance, and system authorization activities across a globally distributed IT portfolio.


This is a primarily remote role; however, due to ongoing federal Return-to-Office policy changes, candidates must reside in the Washington, DC metro area and be prepared to report onsite full-time if required. All classified activities will be performed in a secure government facility.


The selected candidate will serve as a subject matter expert on the implementation of NIST RMF, development of ATO packages, policy compliance, and audit readiness for over 40 FISMA-reportable systems. This position supports the ISSO, coordinates with system owners, and plays a key role in the Department’s continuous monitoring and authorization strategy.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Authorization and Compliance Leadership: Lead the development and maintenance of comprehensive ATO packages, including SSPs, SARs, RARs, and POA&Ms. Ensure documentation aligns with NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and Department-specific security requirements.


RMF Lifecycle Oversight: Oversee all phases of the Risk Management Framework lifecycle from system categorization through continuous monitoring. Ensure timely and accurate assessment of security controls and facilitate authorizations and reauthorizations.


Policy and Governance Support: Interpret and apply Departmental cybersecurity policies, including 12 FAM, 5 FAH-6, and CSB guidelines. Recommend improvements to internal policies, controls, and procedures to align with emerging federal mandates.


Security Impact Analysis and Continuous Monitoring: Lead Security Impact Analyses (SIA) for system changes. Review vulnerability scan results, update control implementation statements, and track remediation progress through governance systems such as ArchAngel.


Audit Readiness and Documentation Quality: Coordinate internal and external audit activities, prepare evidence packages, and respond to data calls. Ensure all documentation is audit-ready, consistent, and current with evolving control requirements.


Mentorship and Cross-Functional Coordination: Advise mid-level analysts and ISSO support staff. Serve as a primary liaison to cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, and system owners to ensure security is integrated into all IT planning and operations.

  • Schedule meetings or demos between prospects and the technical / sales teams.
  • Build rapport with key decision-makers (CIOs, CISOs, IT Managers, Procurement Heads, etc.) at target accounts.
Market & Product Knowledge

  • Stay up to date with the latest trends, technologies, and threat landscapes in Cybersecurity.
  • Acquire a solid understanding of vendors’ products and services across domains like IAM, DLP, SIEM, SASE, Zero Trust, GRC, and Cloud Security.
  • Provide feedback from the market to internal stakeholders for continuous improvement in sales strategy and vendor alignment.

Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Marketing, IT, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience in inside sales, lead generation, or business development, preferably in IT distribution, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.
  • Proven success in converting cold calls into qualified leads and sales opportunities.
  • Experience working with cybersecurity vendors or channel partners is a strong plus.

  • Excellent cold-calling and lead qualification capabilities.

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, etc.).

title: Data Architect - Senior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Architect - Senior based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the data architecture of a large-scale information management and modernization initiative. You will help transform fragmented reporting environments into an integrated enterprise data ecosystem that supports reliable analytics and decision-making. The position combines enterprise data architecture, modeling, ETL, data quality, governance, and reporting validation. You’ll work across complex data environments while helping establish scalable and well-governed solutions. Strong collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders will be essential to translating business needs into effective data architectures. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced data professional who enjoys solving complex information challenges and driving modernization.

Accountabilities

  • Design and support enterprise data architecture for a large-scale data integration and modernization initiative.
  • Help consolidate multiple reporting data marts into an integrated Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), along with supporting data marts and views.
  • Perform data profiling and analysis to understand existing data structures, relationships, quality issues, and integration requirements.
  • Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.
  • Design and support ETL processes for integrating and transforming data from multiple source systems.
  • Work with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and related technologies to build and maintain reliable data integration workflows.
  • Define and implement data quality practices, validation processes, and controls to improve the accuracy and reliability of enterprise data.
  • Support reporting and analytics teams by validating datasets and ensuring data structures meet downstream reporting requirements.
  • Contribute to enterprise data governance, information management, security, and cybersecurity practices.
  • Conduct architecture risk assessments and provide recommendations to address technical and architectural risks.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and other subject-matter experts to translate complex requirements into practical data solutions.
  • Communicate architectural decisions, data models, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Requirements

    • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Management, or a related discipline.
    • 5+ years of experience providing architecture risk assessments and architecture-related services.
    • 2+ years of experience working in or with public-sector environments, with an understanding of public-sector policies and practices.
    • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, and enterprise data solutions.
    • 5+ years of experience using data modeling and architecture tools such as SAP/Sybase PowerDesigner or equivalent platforms.
    • Strong experience with enterprise data warehousing, ETL, data marts, facts, dimensions, and dimensional data modeling.
    • Hands-on experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
    • Strong SQL skills and solid experience working with relational databases.
    • Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence and reporting platforms.
    • Strong understanding of information management, data governance, data quality, and cybersecurity principles.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work through complex data architecture challenges.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
    • Ability to work independently, assess architectural risks, and make sound recommendations in a complex enterprise environment.

      • Benefits

      • Contract opportunity supporting a large-scale data modernization and integration initiative.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Opportunity to contribute to an enterprise-scale data architecture and modernization program.
      • Exposure to complex data warehousing, governance, ETL, reporting, and information management challenges.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders across a significant data transformation initiative.

title: Senior Associate – Corporate Commercial Practice
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Our client is a reputable legal firm delivering outstanding legal services to a broad range of companies, private clients, and governments. They are currently looking to hire a Senior Associate with technical expertise in corporate and commercial law, particularly in leading complex transactions from structuring through completion.

The role is ideal for candidates with hands-on experience in mergers and acquisitions, private equity, joint ventures, corporate restructuring, and capital markets transactions. The candidate must demonstrate skills in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating high-value transaction documents, and have good understanding of corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and transaction risk management.

The Senior Associate will play a key role within the Corporate Practice Group, supporting and leading high-level corporate and commercial transactions, advising local and international clients on complex matters. You will be expected to manage transactions end-to-end, supervise junior lawyers, and work closely with Partners to deliver timely and commercially sound legal advice.


JOB RESPONSIBILITY:
1. Transaction Leadership & Execution:
  • Lead and manage complex corporate and commercial transactions from structuring through execution and completion, including mergers and acquisitions, private equity, joint ventures, corporate restructuring, and business and asset sales.
  • Take primary responsibility for drafting, reviewing, and negotiating high-value transaction documents, including share purchase agreements, subscription agreements, shareholders’ agreements, joint venture agreements, underwriting
  • agreements, and related ancillary documents.
  • Oversee transaction mechanics such as completion processes, escrow arrangements, warranties, indemnities, conditions precedent, and post-completion obligations.

2. Legal Advisory:
  • Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to clients on corporate law, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, and transactional risk.
  • Advise on complex company law issues including capital restructuring, share buybacks, financial assistance, related party transactions, securities offerings, and corporate approvals.
  • Deliver risk-based analysis that clearly explains legal exposure, commercial implications, and mitigation strategies.

3. Due Diligence & Risk Management:
  • Lead and supervise legal due diligence exercises for domestic and cross-border transactions, including structuring the scope of reviews and supervising junior lawyers on execution.
  • Review due diligence reports, including full and exception-only reports, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and commercial relevance.
  • Identify legal, regulatory, and commercial risks early in transactions and proactively manage resolution strategies.

4. Corporate Governance and Company Secretarial Oversight:
  • Provide senior-level support on corporate governance reviews, board evaluations, and regulatory compliance audits.
  • Advise boards and senior management on governance frameworks, board charters, committee terms of reference, and regulatory obligations.
  • Supervise the delivery of company secretarial services, including board and general meetings, statutory filings, and regulatory returns.

5. Client Relationship Management and Business Development:
  • Act as a key point of contact for clients on ongoing matters, maintaining strong working relationships and a high standard of client service.
  • Participate in client negotiations, strategy sessions, and high-level meetings, representing the firm with confidence and professionalism.
  • Support Partners in business development initiatives, including pitching, proposal preparation, client presentations, and relationship expansion.

6. Supervision, Mentoring, and Team Development:
  • Supervise, mentor, and review the work of Associates and Trainees, providing clear guidance, constructive feedback, and technical support.
  • Allocate work appropriately within transaction teams to ensure efficiency, quality, and development of junior lawyers. • Contribute to knowledge sharing, training sessions, and the continuous improvement of team processes and standards.


PERSON SPECIFICATION/JOB REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB) and Call to the Nigerian Bar (BL) minimum
  • Master of Laws (LLM) optional.
  • Minimum of six (6) years’ post-call experience with at least 1 of those years as a Senior Associate providing legal advisory on matters within a commercial law firm.
  • Candidate must possess a demonstrable and applicable knowledge of legal issues pertinent to the corporate commercial/transactional practice.
  • Listens actively and delivers written work which is concise, accurate, with no typos and a high level of attention to detail.
  • Demonstrates highly effective oral and written communication skills. Can succinctly explain core legal issues to colleagues and clients effectively.
  • Ability to recognise, understand, analyse and classify commercial as well as legal issues and the context in which legal issues arise. Use the analysis to identify relevant and applicable concepts and facts as well as identify alternative legal and commercial solutions to issues that arise on transactions.
  • Displays the requisite flexibility in meeting with client demands and is relentlessly focuses on outcomes. Manages time effectively and delivers on the expectations of the corporate services group’s objectives and clients.
  • Ability to note gaps and ambiguities in the information provided and to follow through in resolving them, as well as the ability to conduct proper and extensive research on all matters using relevant and up to date sources
  • Ability to give a risk-based analysis - explaining possible consequences, the likelihood of those consequences, and ways to mitigate or eliminate risk.
  • Brings a sense of tact, discipline and urgency in the delivery of legal services in the Corporate commercial practice.
  • Demonstrates the ability to supervise, mentor, and review the work of junior lawyers, providing guidance, feedback, and support to ensure quality output and professional development.

KNOWLEDGE NNEEDS:
Candidate must have a passable knowledge of commercial law, including, but not limited to:
  • Company Law and corporate advisory.
  • Corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and company secretarial practice.
  • Advanced legal drafting, review, and negotiation of complex transaction documents.
  • Commercial and general contract law.
  • Mergers and acquisitions, including domestic and cross-border transactions.
  • Corporate restructuring, recapitalisation, and post-transaction integration.
  • Capital markets transactions and securities regulation.
  • Private equity and venture capital transactions.
  • Business and asset sales, arrangements, and reorganisations.
  • Strategic alliances, joint ventures, and shareholder arrangements.
  • Legal and regulatory due diligence for corporate and commercial transactions

SKILLS:

  • Strong problem solving, listening and learning skills and analytical thinking.

  • Familiarity with Internet explorer and search engines on the World Wide Web.
  • Administrative ability.
  • Organisational skills with an attention to detail.

Job Description

Join us as a Scientist!

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic experts. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.
As a Scientist, your role will be to perform advanced diagnostic testing and analysis, ensure the accuracy and reliability of laboratory results, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of lab procedures and quality standards.

What You’ll Do:
• Perform a variety of complex sample preparation and analysis procedures to quantitatively measure pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical compounds in a
variety of formulations and /or biological matrices for stability and analytical testing.
• Work with multiple functional groups to meet business needs.
• Plan and organize work with periodic supervision.
• Set up and maintain analytical instrumentation.
• Train in routine operation, maintenance and theory of analytical instrumentation, SOPs and regulatory procedures and guidelines.
• Ensure QA findings are addressed appropriately.
• Provide assistance and training for other team members.
• Problem solving, either independently or with assistance pertaining to extraction and/or instrumentation problems.
• Communicate project status to project leader.
• Perform work assignments accurately, and in a timely and safe manner.
• Review, interpret, and analyze data for technical, quality and compliance to protocols, methods, SOPs, client criteria and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) or Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Perform self and peer review of the data for accuracy and compliance with reporting requirements prior to submission to QA and issuance to customers.

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years).

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Demonstrated knowledge of multiple applicable techniques such as: HPLC, GC, MS, Dissolution Testing, Inhalation Testing, Biopharmaceutical Testing, Karl Fischer, UV-Vis, FT-IR, TOC
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word
• Proven ability to interpret data by performing trend analysis
• Proven ability in technical writing skills
• Ability to independently optimize analytical methods
• Proven problem solving and troubleshooting abilities
• Good written and oral communication skills
• Time management and project management skills
• Ability to work in a collaborative work environment with a team

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in a laboratory and/or a clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Occasional drives to site locations, occasional domestic travel.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, radiation, toxic materials and hazardous waste.
• Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

Physical Requirements:
• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment.
• Occasional mobility needed.
• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
• Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
• Works independently with little guidance or reliance on oral or written instructions and plans work schedules to meet goals. Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.
• Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
• Regular and consistent attendance.

Why Join Us?
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

You will join the Compliance & Internal Audit Analytics team who will develop and own the reporting layer for Compliance activities to give assurance to the Board and our regulators that we are effectively managing the risks we face.

You will do this by partnering very closely with Compliance in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region to ensure they can execute against the compliance regulatory reporting schedule, as well as leveraging data to proactively monitor risks. These activities include regulatory reporting - both routine and ad hoc, as well as compliance monitoring and testing.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

  • Help build a world-class Compliance Analytics team that fosters high trust with our customers and external partners.

  • Travel when needed to our offices across the globe to connect with local compliance experts.

  • Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts, data scientists and Compliance partners that you will work with and learn from.

A bit about you:

  • You're proficient in SQL and comfortable working with relational databases.

  • You have knowledge of data modeling fundamentals and ideally some experience designing and implementing data structures.

  • You have experience with designing and owning data assets; you can build and maintain complex data sources and can leverage visualisation tools (Looker, Superset, etc) to surface insights

  • You understand the importance of data integrity, quality & governance. You know how to produce comprehensive data documentation

  • You have stakeholder management skills; you know how to collaborate with key partners to get the job done

  • You have a strong sense of ownership and care about doing things the right ways

Bonus:

CZYM BEDZIESZ SIĘ ZAJMOWAĆ?

  • Obsługa klientów z wykorzystaniem wiedzy o produktach.

  • budują pozytywne relacje, są otwarte na współpracę i dobrze odnajdują się w pracy z ludźmi,

  • mają gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach otwarcia sklepu, w tym w soboty oraz niedziele handlowe,
  • cenią różnorodność, elastyczność w wykonywanych zadaniach.

Poznaj jednego z naszych Sprzedawców i dowiedz się, jakim pracodawcą jesteśmy tutaj.

UWAŻASZ, ŻE TO PRACA WŁAŚNIE DLA CIEBIE? Aplikuj już dziś!

O NAS

W JYSK ludzie są w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. To ich energia, zaangażowanie i współpraca napędzają nasz rozwój. Dlatego tworzymy środowisko, w którym można się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i budować swoją ścieżkę kariery krok po kroku, w swoim tempie.
Nasza historia sięga 1979 roku, kiedy Lars Larsen otworzył pierwszy sklep w Danii. Od tego czasu rozwinęliśmy się w międzynarodową sieć obecna w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, gdzie mamy już ponad 340 sklepów oraz nowoczesne centrum dystrybucji, które wspiera sprawne funkcjonowanie całej sieci. Rozwijamy zarówno sprzedaż stacjonarną, jak i kanały online, pozostając blisko klientów i ich codziennych potrzeb.
Naszą kulturę definiują trzy wartości: Kupiec, Kolega i Duch Firmy. Przekładają się one na codzienną pracę: odpowiedzialność za wyniki, współpracę w zespole oraz zaangażowanie.
W JYSK stawiamy na środowisko oparte na zaufaniu, szacunku i rozwoju. Wspieramy się nawzajem i dajemy przestrzeń do nauki, niezależnie od miejsca startu.
Jesteśmy organizacją otwartą na różnorodność. Cenimy ludzi bez względu na wiek, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, sprawność, pochodzenie, doświadczenie czy sposób myślenia. Wierzymy, że różne perspektywy, talenty i doświadczenia wzmacniają nasze zespoły i pozwalają nam działać lepiej każdego dnia.

Chcesz uzyskać więcej informacji, odwiedź naszą stronę kariera JYSK.

Dowiedz się, w jaki sposób przetwarzamy Twoje dane osobowe w naszej Polityce Prywatności.

title: Data Architect
description:
Data Architect (Azure) with preferable Teradata Experience

Requirements

Job Title: Data Architect

Experience: 10+ Years (can be adjusted)
Location: [Onsite / Hybrid / Remote]
Employment Type: Full-time


Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to design, build, and govern enterprise-level data architecture that supports analytics, reporting, and advanced data use cases. The role requires close collaboration with business, engineering, and analytics teams to ensure scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions aligned with organizational goals.


Key Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Strategy

· Define and maintain enterprise data architecture, standards, and best practices.

· Design end-to-end data solutions including data ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.

· Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

Data Platforms & Integration

· Architect and oversee data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse solutions.

· Design data integration patterns for batch and real-time processing.

· Ensure seamless integration across multiple source systems and downstream consumers.

Cloud & Technology Leadership

· Lead data architecture on cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).

· Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies (ETL, orchestration, streaming, BI).

· Optimize performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of data platforms.

Governance, Security & Quality

· Define and enforce data governance, lineage, metadata, and quality standards.

· Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

· Collaborate with security teams on data access and protection strategies.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Leadership

· Work with business leaders to translate requirements into data solutions.

· Guide and mentor data engineers and analysts on architecture best practices.

· Participate in architecture review boards and technical decision-making.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

· Strong expertise in data modeling (ER, dimensional, star/snowflake).

· Advanced SQL and database design experience.

· Hands-on experience with data warehousing and data lake architectures.

· Proficiency in cloud data services (e.g., Azure Synapse, AWS Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery).

· Experience with ETL/ELT tools (ADF, Informatica, Glue, dbt, etc.).

· Knowledge of streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs).

Architecture & Frameworks

· Experience with data architecture frameworks (TOGAF, DAMA-DMBOK preferred).

· Strong understanding of metadata management and data lineage.

· Tera Data


Soft Skills

· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

· Strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving ability.


Education

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Nice to Have

· Cloud certifications (AWS / Azure / GCP).

· Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

· Exposure to ML/AI data platforms.

· Experience in regulated industries (banking, healthcare, etc.).

· Experience in Teradata

title: GM - IT Audit
description:
About the role
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Information Security and Cloud Security Auditor to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 3-7 years of expertise in data security and privacy control implementation, internal auditing, third-party risk management, cybersecurity governance, and cloud security (banking sector preferred). This role will be responsible for conducting comprehensive IT and cloud security audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and enhancing our information security policies and procedures.
Key Responsibilities
-Conduct IT and cloud security audits across various domains, including IT General Controls (ITGC), Information Security Controls, Cloud Security, Network Security, Vulnerability Management, and Vendor Risk Assessments.
-Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and organizational policies across both on-premises and cloud environments.
-Develop and enhance information security and cloud security policies and procedures in alignment with industry best practices.
-Maintain thorough documentation of audit findings, risk assessments, security measures, working papers, audit program checklists, and evidence for internal and external reporting.
-Validate ITGC, cloud security, and application-specific controls and manage audit documentation, risk assessments, evidence gathering, and control testing.
-Follow up on audit findings and ensure timely closure of non-compliance and security issues identified during audits.
-Manage and oversee third-party risk assessments and audits, ensuring robust security controls are implemented across traditional and cloud-based service providers.
-Lead and participate in the development, migration, and implementation of security controls and policies for network and cloud security solutions.
-Conduct risk-based security assessments of internal, vendor, and third-party hosted environments, covering both traditional IT infrastructure and cloud environments.
-Participate in product and vendor selection processes, contributing security and risk expertise to the evaluation, implementation, and integration of new technologies, with a strong focus on cloud security solutions.
Experience & Skills Required
-Minimum 10 years of experience in Information Security and Auditing, with a strong background in Cloud Security and the Banking and IT industries.
-Proven experience in conducting IT and cloud security audits, validating ITGC and cloud application controls, and maintaining comprehensive audit documentation.
-Hands-on experience in vulnerability management, risk management, physical security, identity and access management, encryption, secure development, incident management, security infrastructure, and security policies across on-premises and cloud environments.
-Strong expertise in third-party risk management, regulatory compliance, and management of IT audit findings across traditional and cloud-based environments.
-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation abilities.
-Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines effectively.
-Strong understanding of IT, cloud security, cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and industry best practices.
-Proficiency in security assessment tools and technologies, particularly those related to cloud environments.
Qualifications & Certifications
-Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, or a related field.
-Preferred certifications include ISO 27001, CNSS, CCNA, CISA, CISM, and CISSP.
Detailed knowledge of security tools, PCI-DSS, ITGC controls, compliance testing, cloud risk assessment, GRC, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, change management, and security policies and procedures.
-Proficiency in security and cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point Firewalls, SOAR (Cortex), and Forcepoint.

title: Työmaapäällikkö maa- ja pohjarakentamiseen, datakeskushankkeisiin
location: Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, Kuopio, Oulu, fi
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa vastuullista ja kestävää infrastruktuuria?

Mitä ikinä tähän maailmaan rakennetaankin, siihen pitää voida luottaa nyt ja aina. Meille jokainen oman kodin unelma, asiakkaan menestystarina ja kaupungin kokoinen ratkaisu alkaa ihmisistä. Hyvää jälkeä syntyy fiksuista yhteisistä valinnoista, joista tulee parhaalla työllämme ja taidollamme totta. Näin me teemme enemmän kuin rakennamme hyvin. Rakennamme onnistumisen iloa ja arvoa, joka kestää. Hyvin rakennettu huominen tehdään yhdessä.

Etsimme alkaviin uusiin datakeskushankkeisiimme kokenutta maa- ja pohjarakentamisen työmaapäällikköä.

Työmaapäällikkönä toimit keskeisessä roolissa maa- ja pohjarakentamisyksikön datakeskusprojekteissa joko vastaavana työnjohtajana tai pohjarakennustöiden aluevastaavana. Vastaat käynnissä olevan projektisi tuotannosta, turvallisuudesta ja taloudesta yhdessä työpäällikön kanssa.

Työhösi kuuluu projektin aikataulutuksen, laadunhallinnan, kustannusohjauksen ja aliurakoitsijoiden toiminnan johtaminen sekä töiden yhteensovittaminen työmaapäällikön alaisuudessa toimivan projektiorganisaation kanssa. Johdat työmaan toimintaa valmentavalla ja jämäkällä otteella, varmistat resurssien tehokkaan käytön ja työvaiheiden turvallisen toteutuksen.

Vastaat myös kokousten ja katselmusten järjestämisestä, teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaan ja viranomaisten kanssa sekä toimit esihenkilönä omalle työmaaorganisaatiollesi. Osallistut tarvittaessa urakkaneuvotteluihin ja urakkasisällön määrittelyyn tarjousvaiheessa.

Miksi YIT:lle?

Tapamme toimia pohjautuu arvoihimme: arvostus, yhteistyö, luovuus ja intohimo. Ne ohjaavat meitä päivittäisessä työssämme menestymään yhdessä, luomaan uutta ja toimimaan eettisesti, kestävästi ja laadukkaasti. YIT:llä olemme sitoutuneet neljään kulttuurin kulmakiveen: asiakaslähtöinen, korkea suorituskyky, oppiva ja inhimillinen. Ymmärrämme asiakkaidemme tarpeet ja kehitämme liiketoimintaamme yhdessä heidän kanssaan. Asetamme riman korkealle kaikessa mitä teemme, johtaen tiedolla ja esimerkillä. Haluamme jatkuvasti parantaa osaamistamme ja kehittyä. Inhimillisyys näkyy meillä turvallisuudessa, henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnissa ja erinomaisena ihmisten johtamisena.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Teknillisen koulun, ammattikorkeakoulun tai vastaavan rakennusalan perustutkinto (kotimainen tai ulkomainen)
  • Vähintään viiden vuoden kokemus työnjohto- tai toimihenkilötehtävistä infrarakentamisessa sekä näyttöä hyvin johdetuista työmaista
  • Hyvä suomen ja englannin kielen taito (suullinen ja kirjallinen)
  • Matkustusvalmius työmaiden sijainnin mukaan

Sinulla on vahva osaaminen tuotannonohjauksesta, kustannustenhallinnasta ja sopimusasioista. Hallitset tehtävässä tarvittavat IT-taidot ja hyödynnät sujuvasti YIT:n käytössä olevia järjestelmiä.

Olet jämäkkä ja yhteistyökykyinen esihenkilö, joka johtaa turvallisuutta esimerkillään ja pystyy tekemään päätöksiä myös paineen alla. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot sekä kyky hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia ja ohjata työmaata tavoitteellisesti. Analyyttinen ajattelutapa, toimeenpanokyky ja asiakaslähtöinen ote tukevat onnistumistasi tehtävässä.

Työskentelet valmentavalla ja ratkaisukeskeisellä otteella, joka tukee tiimin sitoutumista ja kehittymistä. Kykenet sopeutumaan muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja viemään asiat maaliin määrätietoisesti.

Mitä voit odottaa meiltä?

Toimimme vastuullisesti ja kestävästi. Olemme sitoutuneet ympäristöystävällisiin käytäntöihin ja yhteiskuntavastuuseen. Etsimme aktiivisesti tapoja pienentää oman toimintamme ympäristövaikutuksia. Haluamme tarjota turvallisen ja terveellisen työ- ja elinympäristön henkilöstöllemme, yhteistyökumppaneillemme, asiakkaillemme sekä muille sidosryhmillemme.

Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi on meille ensisijaisen tärkeää. Vaikka teemme ahkerasti hommia, pidämme huolta ihmisistämme ja heidän hyvinvoinnistaan. Panostamme työturvallisuuteen ja varmistamme, että työympäristömme on turvallinen kaikille. Tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut työhyvinvoinnin tueksi.

Vaalimme vahvaa yhteisöllisyyden kulttuuria. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ja tuemme toisiamme saavuttaaksemme yhteiset tavoitteet. Meillä on pitkiä työuria ja sitoutunut henkilöstö. Viimeisimmässä henkilöstökyselyssä suositteluindeksimme (eNPS) on erinomaisella tasolla.

Rakennamme oppivaa organisaatiota. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa, joissa voit hyödyntää osaamistasi sekä kehittää uusia taitoja ja urapolkuasi haluamaasi suuntaan. Kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia jatkuvaan oppimiseen.

title: Consultant – Pediatric Otolaryngology (ENT)
description:

Provide advanced medical and surgical ENT care for children, including complex airway, otology, sleep and congenital disorders. The successful physician will combine excellent clinical judgment with compassionate communication, multidisciplinary teamwork and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.

Key responsibilities

· Assess and manage pediatric airway, ear, hearing, sleep-disordered breathing, sinus, swallowing and congenital head-and-neck conditions.

· Perform pediatric ENT procedures within approved privileges, including complex airway and otologic work where competent.

· Provide emergency consultation and consultant on-call coverage.

· Collaborate with pulmonology, audiology, speech and language therapy, anesthesia, intensive care and surgical specialties.

· Maintain surgical outcomes and contribute to multidisciplinary clinics, audit, teaching, research and service development.

· Provide safe, evidence-based, patient- and family-centered consultant care in accordance with professional standards, hospital policies and approved clinical privileges.

· Supervise junior medical staff, support multidisciplinary decision-making and promote effective communication with patients and families.

· Participate in clinical governance, incident review, quality improvement, credentialing, continuing professional development and departmental education.

· Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and comply with infection prevention, medication safety, privacy and regulatory requirements.



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

Education and specialist qualifications

· Medical degree, recognized Otolaryngology/ENT specialty qualification, and accredited Pediatric Otolaryngology fellowship or substantial formal pediatric ENT training.

· The exact specialty and subspecialty award must be recognized under the current UAE Professional Qualification Requirements and support the requested Consultant title.

· Completion of internship and active, unrestricted professional registration/licensure in the current or most recent country of practice.

Experience and licensing

· Tier 1 qualification and DOH Consultant-level experience with substantial recent pediatric ENT surgical practice.

· Candidates must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Department of Health – Abu Dhabi Consultant licence for the applicable base specialty/title.

· Applicants must demonstrate recent clinical activity, competence within the advertised scope and no unresolved licensing, credentialing or professional-standing concerns.

· For Tier 1 vacancies, the exact Tier 1 award is mandatory. As a general screening guide, the Consultant route normally requires at least two years after the main specialty award or one year after a recognized subspecialty award, subject to DOH assessment.

Role-specific requirements

· Current BLS, ACLS and PALS.

· Detailed pediatric airway and surgical logbook.

· Complex airway, otology, sleep and congenital neck experience is strongly preferred.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

Documents required with the application

· Updated, detailed CV showing month/year dates, hospital, country, job title, specialty scope and any career gaps.

· Valid passport copy and recent professional photograph.

· Primary medical degree, internship certificate, main specialty board/certificate and relevant subspecialty fellowship/board.

· Current and previous medical licences/registrations and a recent Good Standing Certificate.

· Employer experience certificates confirming exact dates, title, specialty and full-time clinical service.

· Current BLS/ACLS/PALS and other role-specific certificates, as applicable.

· Procedure/case logbook and current privilege list for surgical, procedural or technology-dependent roles.

· Existing DataFlow/PSV report or UIN and DOH eligibility/licence, if already available.

· Contact details for two or three recent clinical referees, preferably a Department Chair, Medical Director or direct Consultant supervisor.

Submit your updated CV and supporting credentials through the Black Pearl website. Please ensure your application clearly states the exact specialty and subspecialty board/fellowship, current licence status, post-qualification experience and present location. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a confidential discussion and document review.

Final appointment is subject to primary-source verification, DOH licensing, facility credentialing, references and pre-employment requirements.

title: Restaurangansvarig till Kvikkjokk Fjällstation sensommaren 2026
description:
Kvikkjokk ligger längst in i den Lappländska fjällvärlden - vid vägs ände. Den som söker naturens skönhet, bör besöka Kvikkjokk. I anslutning till Kvikkjokk ligger de två stora nationalparkerna Padjelanta och Sarek som tillsammans med Stora Sjöfallet också utgör världsarvsområdet Laponia som inrättades 1995 av Unesco.

Det finns 50 bäddar med enkel- till flerbäddsrum i två byggnader. Den timrade byggnaden från 1928 med trivsamma rum och sällskapsrum med utsikt över Sarekfjällen. Vi erbjuder förutom restaurang även café och bar samt en mindre butik.

Kvikkjokk är en liten by och det är 12 mil till Jokkmokk som är närmaste samhälle. Våra gäster söker naturupplevelser och många ger sig ut på längre eller kortare hivandringar.

Vi söker nu en restaurangansvarig som kan sköta vår restaurang och ta hand om våra gäster nu till sensommaren nu i augusti till början av oktober.

Vi ser att du är en glad, positiv och serviceinriktad person som gillar att arbeta över avdelningsgränserna, noggrann, organiserad och engagerad person med stort hjärta för mat och god kunskap kring vin och öl. Du jobbar bra både självständigt och i lag

Vi använder oss av kassasystemet Trivec.

Vårt kök är uppskattat bland våra gäster och är av stor betydelse för anläggningen. Vi serverar en enklare café &snackmeny 11.00-16.00 och kvälls meny från 18.00. Vi arbetar mycket med viltkött och fjällfisk.

Vi är ett litet team som stöttar varandra

Att jobba på fjällstation innebär att personalen bor, lever och arbetar tillsammans under några månader. Boende ingår och kostavdrag görs under arbetsperioden.

Vi arbetar enligt kollektivavtal mellan HRF och VISITA.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work through complex data architecture challenges.

    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

title: Senior Regional Quality Assurance Manager
description:
The Senior Regional Quality Manager is responsible for providing leadership, direction, and resource stewardship for our Windows & Doors quality organization; specifically, this role will lead quality assurance at 5-7 facilities within the South Region. She/he will lead the execution of cross-functional strategies and plans that ensure we execute the company’s production system quality control roadmap.

Successful candidates demonstrate their commitment to their team by taking direct responsibility for the safety of the people, build trust and value the experience of the team around them and look to develop the people, sets high expectations for self and others, is a change agent and an effective communicator, encourages cross-functional collaboration, and shows personal resilience. This position directly reports to the Director of Quality for Windows & Doors business unit.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Foster a culture, including ways of working and behaviors, that is congruent with our mission, values, mindsets, and success model.
  • Identify and implement ways of working that make quality first a shared mindset and a way of life at CBB. Focus will be on the process, not the individual.
  • Ability to lead by influence, build strong business relationships, and work collaboratively across multiple functions and regions.
  • End to end quality responsibility: design, manufacturing, and customer satisfaction.
  • Monitor the Windows & Doors business unit customer satisfaction and internal metrics (Cost of Poor Quality), drive initiatives and projects to improve quality as a competitive advantage.
  • Support the development and drive the execution of the Cornerstone Production System Quality Control Pillar
  • Lead the effort to leverage best practices and standardize processes and procedures across the factories to meet company objectives and customer expectations.
  • Responsible for the review, update, and approval of applicable documents such as process maps, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effect Analysis), control plan, reliable testing, other testing, etc.
  • Development and execution of the Critical to Quality (CTQ) station and key initiatives as part of the Strategic Annual Plan.
  • Explore, identify, and pursue new technologies that improve effectiveness of our quality control systems including error and mistake proof solutions, digital, real-time quality assurance systems.
  • Evaluate new and existing regulations to ensure the quality assurance protocols fulfill requirements.
  • Lead and/or facilitate team problem solving events for customer and internal quality issues to find true root cause and develop permanent Corrective Actions.
  • Invest significant effort on talent offense and aligning training and development of teams to mindsets and skillsets critical to the future of our business. Teach, coach, direct, and inform other quality professionals to promote performance and encourage professional development.
  • Understand that speed matters and is prompt with action and information, willing to make decisions based on calculated risks, and moves issues to closure by driving teams forward.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field.
  • Master’s degree preferred and MBA a plus.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.

  • Enthusiastic about the value quality brings to the manufacturing process and passionate about keeping technical skills up to date, understanding best practices, and deploying quality systems to achieve goals and targets.
  • Progressive experience in quality technical field and leadership roles, preferably in manufacturing.
  • Displays a strong ability to use data to rationally analyze and solve issues, with a solid understanding of statistical concepts and methods for appropriate application and analysis.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to train staff.
  • Thorough understanding of quality control standards and methodologies.
  • 3rd party Quality certification (ISO 9001/TS 16949) experience preferred.
  • Thorough understanding of manufacturing and production in the industry.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Head of Cross Asset Strategy
description:
The Pepperstone story started in 2010. We know what it’s like to trade the world’s markets. Our team describes us as a place for the curious and the driven, and we like to do things a little differently; as a transformative global fintech we’re digital, nimble, connected and united in our vision to create a better way to trade.

We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global and results focused.

You’ll find our 700+ team currently across 12 locations and 9 time zones.

The Role

We are hiring our Head of Cross Asset Strategy, a newly created leadership role sitting at the centre of our next phase of growth. This is a rare opportunity to work with the best of both our CFD and Crypto teams and shape the product strategy that brings them together.

Reporting to our Chief Operating Officer, you'll work alongside our senior leaders across CFD and Crypto and reach into product, marketing, legal and our commercial teams in market. It's a hands on role with a lot of autonomy to shape and drive the agenda, calling for the analysis, commercial judgement and frameworks that help a fast moving global business make big calls with confidence. You'll also set the frameworks our regional teams work from, giving them a consistent way to weigh up opportunities in their own markets.

This role suits someone with excellent strategic judgement who can bring senior teams along on the strength of their thinking, and who wants to see their strategy through to delivery.

As our Head of Cross Asset Strategy, your key responsibilities include, but may not be limited to:

  • Developing and driving our global growth strategy alongside senior leaders, and maintaining a live roadmap that shows where the business is tracking and what needs attention
  • Owning the cross asset proposition agenda, designing the products, journeys and commercial structures that combine CFD and Crypto into an offer clients cannot get elsewhere
  • Working with commercial leaders and our in market teams to identify and activate the highest value growth opportunities, so local insight shapes global strategy
  • Partnering with commercial leadership to unlock more value from our existing client base across Crypto and CFD
  • Connecting commercial ambition to product execution, advocating for commercially led priorities on the roadmap and turning approved opportunities into initiatives teams can deliver
  • Lead the strategic assessment, planning and cross-functional execution of country and market expansion opportunities
  • Leading the development of rigorous business cases for major growth initiatives with clear financial modelling, risk assessment and strategic rationale, and maintain a prioritisation framework
  • Driving a culture of commercial rigour and innovation across the business – setting a high bar for the quality of strategic thinking, business case development and growth execution.

About you

  • 8+ years in senior commercial, growth strategy or product leadership across crypto, fintech, trading or regulated financial services, working at a global or multi market level
  • Deep knowledge of the global crypto and digital asset ecosystem, including exchange dynamics, product economics, institutional markets and the regulatory picture
  • A track record of building and delivering growth strategies globally, spanning new product launches, market expansion and senior level business cases backed by solid financial modelling
  • A strong grasp of pricing strategy and monetisation in digital asset or financial services businesses
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and cross functional teams across product, engineering, marketing and compliance, carrying authority without relying on reporting lines
  • Highly analytical, comfortable turning market and commercial insight into clear strategic action
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a talent for distilling complexity into something senior leaders can act on
  • A self starter who thrives in fast paced, build from scratch environments and is comfortable with ambiguity

Why you will enjoy working with us

  • Competitive salary structure including company bonus scheme
  • Genuinely collaborative and friendly culture
  • Flexible and hybrid working
  • Remote working option - work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, in addition to hybrid working as standard
  • Ongoing personal development & learning opportunities
  • 3 paid volunteering days per year & Workplace Giving Program
  • Frequent events and celebrations including a standard weekly social

More About Pepperstone

We’re a regulated online Forex and CFD trading platform. With the scale of a global fintech and the agility of a start-up, we arm our clients with everything they need to take on the global markets with confidence. You will be part of a wider passionate and friendly team, and whilst things may not always go to plan, we learn quickly and move forward with impact. To learn even more visit Pepperstonecareers and

description:
Work Schedule

Job Description

Field Application Scientist – Bioprocessing

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are offering an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated and technically skilled Field Application Scientist (FAS) – Bioprocessing to join our team in South Korea.

As a Field Application Scientist, you will serve as a trusted scientific and technical partner to our customers, providing application expertise across bioprocessing and filtration technologies. You will work closely with customers to understand their processes and technical challenges, develop fit-for-purpose solutions, and support successful evaluation and implementation of our technologies.

Working in close partnership with the Sales team, you will provide the technical and scientific expertise required throughout the customer engagement process, while Sales maintains ownership of the commercial relationship and sales process. Through strong application knowledge and customer engagement, you will help differentiate our solutions, uncover technical opportunities, and contribute to sustainable business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Provide on-site scientific and technical consultation to customers, with a primary focus on bioprocessing and filtration applications.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer processes, workflows, and technical challenges and recommend appropriate solutions based on application and process requirements.
  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert during customer engagements, supporting the Sales team with scientific, application, and process expertise.
  • Deliver technical seminars, presentations, product demonstrations, and training sessions to customers, sharing application expertise and industry best practices.
  • Provide technical consultation and troubleshooting to resolve customer application challenges and support successful implementation of solutions.
  • Design, plan, and conduct laboratory experiments, application studies, and filter evaluations to support customer projects, product evaluations, and technical investigations.
  • Analyze experimental data and translate technical findings into clear, practical recommendations for customers.
  • Support customer product evaluations and technical decision-making by developing appropriate evaluation approaches, success criteria, and technical recommendations.
  • Identify application opportunities and unmet technical needs within customer processes and collaborate with Sales to develop appropriate customer solutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with scientists, engineers, process development teams, manufacturing teams, and other technical stakeholders at customer organizations.
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional and global teams to communicate customer requirements, technical feedback, and emerging market and application needs.
  • Capture and share application knowledge, customer insights, and best practices to strengthen organizational technical capabilities and customer support.

Collaboration with Sales

The Field Application Scientist and Sales teams work as close partners with distinct but complementary responsibilities.

The FAS owns the scientific and technical engagement, including understanding customer process requirements, technical consultation, application development, product evaluation, troubleshooting, and technical recommendations.

The Sales team owns the commercial engagement, including account strategy, opportunity management, pricing, quotation, negotiation, forecasting, and commercial closure.

Together, FAS and Sales develop customer solutions that combine strong technical value with commercial execution, helping customers achieve successful outcomes while supporting sustainable business growth.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree or higher in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in bioprocessing, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, filtration, process development, or a closely related field.
  • Strong understanding of bioprocessing workflows and principles, preferably including clarification, sterile filtration, or related upstream/downstream filtration applications.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience with the ability to independently plan, execute, analyze, and document experiments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand customer processes and translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate scientific and technical information to different customer audiences.
  • Strong customer-facing mindset and demonstrated ability to establish credibility and build trusted technical relationships.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while effectively collaborating with Sales, regional/global technical teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Korean.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with or supporting biopharmaceutical manufacturers, CDMOs, or other customers within the bioprocessing industry.
  • Experience conducting customer-facing technical presentations, application studies, product evaluations, or troubleshooting activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with commercial teams while maintaining ownership of scientific and technical activities.

title: Consultant Paediatric Vascular Surgeon
description:
A leading government healthcare organization in Abu Dhabi is seeking an experienced Consultant Pediatric Vascular Surgeon.

Job Summary

The Consultant Pediatric Vascular Surgeon will provide highly specialized surgical care for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital and acquired vascular disorders. The role involves advanced diagnostic evaluation, operative and endovascular management, and multidisciplinary collaboration, in strict compliance with Abu Dhabi Department of Health (DOH) Professional Qualification Requirements (PQR).

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Deliver consultant-level care in pediatric vascular surgery.

  • Independently assess, diagnose, and manage pediatric vascular conditions, including:

    • Congenital vascular malformations (arterial, venous, lymphatic)

    • Hemangiomas and complex vascular tumors

    • Pediatric peripheral vascular disease

    • Vascular trauma in children

    • Access surgery for pediatric patients (as applicable)

  • Perform complex open and endovascular vascular procedures appropriate to pediatric patients.

  • Lead pre-operative planning, surgical intervention, and post-operative care.

  • Provide emergency and on-call vascular services as per hospital rota.

  • Offer expert consultations and second opinions.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with:

    • Pediatric surgery

    • Interventional radiology

    • Pediatric plastic surgery

    • Dermatology

    • Oncology

    • Neonatology and pediatrics

  • Participate in vascular anomaly and MDT meetings.

Academic, Teaching & Research

  • Supervise and mentor residents, fellows, and junior consultants.

  • Participate in teaching, clinical audits, and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Engage in clinical research and service development where applicable.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with:

    • DOH PQR standards

    • Hospital clinical governance policies

    • Patient safety, infection control, and ethical standards

  • Maintain accurate and compliant clinical documentation and coding practices.



Requirements

Qualifications & Experience (As per DOH PQR – Consultant Level)

Mandatory Qualifications

  • MBBS or equivalent medical degree from a recognized institution.

  • Recognized Specialty Qualification in Vascular Surgery or General Surgery with Vascular Surgery certification, such as:

    • American Board of Surgery + Vascular Surgery subspecialty

    • UK CCT in Vascular Surgery

    • Canadian Board or equivalent (DOH-recognized)

    • Irish Board

    • Australian Board

  • Formal fellowship training in Pediatric Vascular Surgery from an accredited institution (mandatory).

Experience Requirements


  • Minimum 3 years post-fellowship experience as a Consultant
    OR


  • Minimum 5 years post-specialty experience in a recognized tertiary pediatric or vascular center.

  • Demonstrated independent practice in pediatric vascular surgery.

Licensing

  • Eligible for or holding a DOH (Abu Dhabi) Consultant License with Pediatric Vascular Surgery scope of practice.

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced expertise in pediatric vascular and endovascular techniques.

  • Strong clinical judgment and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication skills with children, families, and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Commitment to evidence-based practice and continuous professional development.

  • Leadership skills suitable for a tertiary referral center.


  • WORK LOCATION - ABU DHABI.

The ideal candidate is not only an expert in AV and automation systems but also passionate about knowledge sharing, delivering impactful training sessions and support to System Integrators and industry partners.

This position involves collaborating with clients and partners to assess needs and develop customized AV solutions, while ensuring quality control and experience assurance from design to implementation.

Core Responsibilities:

Design & Engineering
- Create detailed engineering documentation, including:
- First-fix rough-in layouts
- Schematic drawings
- Rack elevations
- Acoustic construction drawings
- Lighting control schematics
- Device placement and integration details
- Ensure all designs meet both functional and aesthetic requirements for residential and workspace environments.
- Translate project scopes and client needs into actionable designs, in collaboration with clients and project managers.
- Utilize tools such as AutoCAD or Revit to generate precise schematics and 3D renderings.

Training & Enablement
- Design and deliver Pre-sales and Post-sales AV Experience Design Training sessions for System Integrators and industry partners.
- Develop high-quality training presentations and resources that communicate integration best practices and emerging technologies.
- Provide continuous support and guidance to System Integrators to ensure high standards of execution on every project.

Project Oversight & Collaboration
- Oversee on-site implementation of designs, ensuring alignment with specifications and industry standards.
- Work closely with the engineering team to facilitate the accurate execution of technical drawings.
- Engage with industry partners to analyze client needs and recommend bespoke AV and automation solutions.
- Support sales efforts by creating and delivering dynamic, technically-informed AV experience presentations.

Innovation & Standards
- Create advanced AV system concepts including acoustic treatments, 3D visuals, and immersive design renders.
- Develop architectural lighting designs, scope of work documentation, equipment BoMs, quotations, and lighting control schedules.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in AV technology, maintaining certifications in the AVIXA design track or equivalent.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Design Quality: Accuracy, completeness, and aesthetic alignment of engineering design documentation.
- Training Impact: Effectiveness of training sessions, measured by participant feedback and performance outcomes.
- Implementation Success: High fidelity between design documentation and executed installations.
- Client Satisfaction: Positive client feedback on system performance, usability, and design quality.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, AV Technology, Architecture, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Strong background in AV system design, especially within residential and workspace environments.
- Experience working with AutoCAD, Revit, or similar design software.
- Solid understanding of lighting, acoustics, and system integration best practices.
- Demonstrated experience designing and delivering training programs.
- Active AVIXA certification (CTS-D or equivalent) preferred.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Creative, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning.

title: Senior Footwear Materials Developer, Asia
description:
Who We Are:

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success:

  • Runner First
    • We act in the best interest of the runner
  • Word is Bond
    • We do what we say we’ll do
  • Champion Heart
    • We give our all in everything we do
  • There is no “I” in Run
    • We stay generous with our humanity
  • Keep Moving
    • We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!

We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.


Your Job:

As our Senior Footwear Materials Developer, Asia, you will play a key role in our material process from concept to commercialization. You will work cross-functionally with the global product creation team, suppliers, and Asia factories to drive our material development process, timelines, and standards. You will partner on projects from concept to production with your corresponding US Material Developer to bring advanced materials with high performance to our products. You will carry out the research and development in materials which fuel and support the overall development and design efforts for the footwear team. Utilizing your strong technical skills, in-depth knowledge of footwear material properties and knowledge of sustainable materials trends, you’ll bring new materials and capabilities to the team and work closely with vendors to ensure that Brooks’ footwear product goals are achieved. As a key member of the materials team, you’ll explore, research, and develop various materials including knits, woven, non-woven, synthetics and all other materials used in footwear.

Your Responsibilities:

MATERIALS DEVELOPMENT

  • Lead in the development of technical textile designs, material toolbox creation through all physical testing, creation, and commercialization.
  • Manage designated projects focused on core product projects across multiple timelines including validating materials both on and off products.
  • Work across the supply chain to create materials, validate them, and ensure that products can be made and commercialized with all footwear materials.
  • Evaluate the risk factors associated with all material developments and communicate them to the product teams.
  • Submit, manage, and provide feedback on color lab dip Identify options to address risks and lead the execution of solutions.
  • Evaluate the risk factors associated with all material developments and communicate them to the product teams. Identify options to address risks and lead the execution of solutions.
  • Organize processes and measures that result in timely delivery of quality materials while also providing an action plan to incorporate into a seasonal calendar for the assigned projects.
  • Contribute to advanced materials R&D projects, as necessary.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Collaborate with Development, Design, and Product Management to develop materials specifications for product functionality, durability, and aesthetics, including identifying needs and researching solutions with good understanding about the material creation process and a certain level knowledge of the textile/yarn/machinery and knitting methods.
  • Partner with Corporate Sustainability to manage the footwear initiatives pertinent to global laws, business requirements, and consumer expectations. Evaluate new product /materials applications to improve cost, reduce environmental impact or improve quality of Brooks’ products.
  • Coordinate and review with Asia materials testing team, to ensure that materials pass Brooks commercialization process by the specified dates on the seasonal calendar.
  • Review testing with development team to ensure product quality. Recommend adjustments as needed to hit testing requirements.

MATERIALS DATA & LIBRARY MANAGEMENT

  • Ensure that Brooks has accurate complete specification sheets on all materials used in the product line.
  • Develop and maintain an organized materials library, complete with up-to-date materials, testing history and specifications.

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

  • Lead the collaboration with vendors (mills/textiles, synthetics, hardware, and other suppliers) to develop materials that align with Brooks’ quality standards, aesthetics, target prices, and availability needs.
  • Attend material shows, meeting regularly with suppliers for line reviews and traveling to vendors to deliver on materials goals & objectives.
  • Negotiate with Tier 2 vendors on delivery timelines for materials for the assigned projects, collecting the key take-aways during the whole process implementation of the assigned projects to create the best practices.
  • Engage in feedback for yearly supplier audit process owned by the Sourcing Operations team.
  • Travel to suppliers two or more times per year and ensure regular ongoing communication with suppliers.

INNOVATION

  • Stay up to date with ongoing research and development to enhance the existing and record materials database.
  • Continuously build advanced materials expertise and make recommendations for our products; create and build a network of contacts within the industry.
  • Other responsibilities as required.

Your Qualifications:

  • BS in Textile Engineering, Textile Design, Materials Engineering, Textile Chemistry, or related fields; may be substituted with relevant work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience leading the material development of high-performance footwear projects.
  • Experience with international material vendors
  • Solid understanding of footwear construction methods, materials, testing & evaluation techniques. Ability to understand how materials play a part in the fit and feel of performance footwear.
  • Ability to analyze test information and provide subjective feedback in a concise and understanding manner.
  • Keen attention to detail in planning, organization, and execution of tasks, all the while observing the big picture and understanding how everything fits. Willingness to dive into the details.
  • Knowledge of textile manufacturing, dying, finishing, and testing.
  • Computer proficiency with office software; MS Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint.
  • Ability to analyze test information and subjective feedback in a concise and understandable manner.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, demonstrating effective listening through concise, clear verbal and written communication.
  • Great interpersonal skills that inspire and build trust resulting in effective working relationships across the company.
  • Keen attention to detail in planning, organization, and execution of tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how all the pieces fit together and affect one another.
  • Ability to anticipate how a decision made can affect our customers, our partners, our products or other departments’ operations and/or morale; “connecting the dots.”
  • Demonstration of innovation and initiative – always looking at improving our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary.
  • Passionate participation in Brooks’ sports activities a plus, overridden by the ability to understand and empathize with the runner in order to develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community.
  • A good problem solver, able to make many decisions with certain support and able to collaborate and question Factory Developers, Engineering, and Production to get answer to key questions.
  • Willingness to travel (Domestic/ International).

title: DTC & eCom Growth Strategist
description:
