This role is designed for a commercially minded growth strategist who can connect paid media, finance, analytics, and broader business strategy to drive profitable growth. You’ll advise established DTC and eCommerce brands and work directly with founders and senior leadership teams. Rather than focusing solely on campaign performance, you’ll evaluate the full commercial picture and identify opportunities across acquisition, creative, customer behavior, operations, and financial planning. You’ll own strategic client relationships and influence high-value business decisions through data-backed recommendations. The role offers significant autonomy, exposure to sophisticated eCommerce businesses, and opportunities to develop deeper expertise in financial modeling and growth strategy. It is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to evolve from performance marketing into a trusted commercial advisor and future growth leader.

Accountabilities

  • Lead paid media and acquisition strategy across platforms such as Google, Meta, and other relevant growth channels, connecting channel performance to broader commercial objectives.
  • Build commercial forecasts and financial models using metrics such as contribution margin, LTV:CAC, aMER, profitability, and growth projections.
  • Translate complex marketing, financial, and performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for founders and senior stakeholders.
  • Identify and evaluate growth opportunities across acquisition, creative strategy, offers, customer behavior, funnels, products, inventory, operations, and seasonality.
  • Lead strategic conversations with founders and senior leadership, acting as a trusted advisor on growth and commercial decisions.
  • Own high-value client relationships from strategy through execution, ensuring recommendations lead to measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with creative strategy, ad operations, and leadership teams to align marketing activity with commercial priorities.
  • Coach teammates and contribute to the development of internal growth frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve profitability, sustainable growth, and long-term business performance rather than optimizing individual campaigns in isolation.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience managing multi-channel 7–8 figure eCommerce portfolios, with a strong track record of influencing meaningful business outcomes.
    • Proven experience in paid media, performance marketing, or growth strategy combined with a strong understanding of commercial business drivers.
    • Advanced financial literacy, including contribution margin, LTV modeling, forecasting, financial analysis, and unit economics.
    • Strong ability to connect marketing performance data with broader commercial recommendations and business strategy.
    • Experience advising founders, executives, or senior leadership teams and communicating complex ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated ability to build integrated growth strategies spanning marketing, finance, operations, products, and customer behavior.
    • Experience solving complex eCommerce growth challenges involving platforms, funnels, inventory, seasonality, acquisition, and profitability.
    • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to make decisions based on data and commercial trade-offs.
    • Proven ability to independently manage high-value client relationships and operate as a trusted strategic advisor.
    • An entrepreneurial, business-owner mindset with a focus on solving commercial problems rather than simply optimizing advertising platforms.
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and provide thoughtful recommendations.
    • Availability to overlap with Australian working hours, including approximately 2:00 PM–6:00 PM Australian time for meetings, training, and client collaboration.
    • Commitment to a full-time, exclusive role and an interest in progressing toward broader growth leadership responsibilities.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation negotiated according to experience, capabilities, and demonstrated impact, with a commitment to matching your current or most recent salary and higher compensation available for exceptional candidates.
      • Opportunity to work directly with established 8- and 9-figure DTC and eCommerce brands and influence meaningful commercial decisions.
      • Clear competency-based career progression toward broader strategic growth leadership.
      • Ongoing learning and development across eCommerce growth, data science, creative strategy, financial modeling, and commercial strategy.
      • Access to proprietary tools, forecasting frameworks, and performance dashboards.
      • Fully remote work environment with flexibility and collaboration across a global team.
      • Annual team retreats and regular opportunities to connect with colleagues internationally.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over client strategy, growth initiatives, and business outcomes.
      • Opportunity to deepen expertise in commercial strategy, financial modeling, leadership, and sustainable growth.

title: Projekti-insinööri maa- ja pohjarakentamiseen, datakeskushankkeisiin
location: Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, Kuopio, Oulu, fi
description:
Mitä ikinä tähän maailmaan rakennetaankin, siihen pitää voida luottaa nyt ja aina. Meille jokainen oman kodin unelma, asiakkaan menestystarina ja kaupungin kokoinen ratkaisu alkaa ihmisistä. Hyvää jälkeä syntyy fiksuista yhteisistä valinnoista, joista tulee parhaalla työllämme ja taidollamme totta. Näin me teemme enemmän kuin rakennamme hyvin. Rakennamme onnistumisen iloa ja arvoa, joka kestää. Hyvin rakennettu huominen tehdään yhdessä.

Etsimme nyt projekti-insinööriä maa- ja pohjarakentamisen datakeskustiimiin

Projekti-insinöörinä vastaat hankkeen tavoitteiden mukaisesta toteutumisesta eri osa-alueilla, kuten aikataulutuksessa, taloudessa, laadussa, hankinnoissa ja ympäristöasioissa. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi aikataulujen optimointi, talousseuranta, laadun varmistaminen tai keskeisten hankintojen kilpailukykyinen ja laadukas toteutus. Työskentelyssäsi painottuvat myös kiertotalouden periaatteet. Tuotat korkealaatuista raportointia sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Tarkka tehtävänkuvasi sovitaan osaamisesi ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti.

Miksi YIT:lle?

Tapamme toimia pohjautuu arvoihimme: arvostus, yhteistyö, luovuus ja intohimo. Ne ohjaavat meitä päivittäisessä työssämme menestymään yhdessä, luomaan uutta ja toimimaan eettisesti, kestävästi ja laadukkaasti. YIT:llä olemme sitoutuneet neljään kulttuurin kulmakiveen: asiakaslähtöinen, korkea suorituskyky, oppiva ja inhimillinen. Ymmärrämme asiakkaidemme tarpeet ja kehitämme liiketoimintaamme yhdessä heidän kanssaan. Asetamme riman korkealle kaikessa mitä teemme, johtaen tiedolla ja esimerkillä. Haluamme jatkuvasti parantaa osaamistamme ja kehittyä. Inhimillisyys näkyy meillä turvallisuudessa, henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnissa ja erinomaisena ihmisten johtamisena.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Odotamme sinulta tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. DI/Ins/Rkm) sekä aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä. Maa- ja pohjarakentaminen ja työmaakäytännöt ovat sinulle tuttuja. Käytät sujuvasti erilaisia IT-järjestelmiä sekä kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Hyödynnät työssäsi vahvaa osaamistasi hankkeen keskeisillä osa-alueilla, kuten laadun, aikataulujen ja kustannusten hallinnassa.

Menestyt tässä roolissa, kun sinulla on vahvaa projektiosaamista sekä asiakaslähtöinen tapa toimia. Sinulla on järjestelmällinen ja analyyttinen ote yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseen sekä hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot, ja toimit tehokkaasti myös paineen alla.

Arvostamme osaamista FIDIC-sopimusehdoista, mutta tarjoamme myös kattavan koulutuksen eri sopimustyyppien hallintaan. Hankkeet sijaitsevat ympäri Suomea, joten tehtävä edellyttää matkustusvalmiutta. Aiempi kokemus suurhankkeista katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä voit odottaa meiltä?

Toimimme vastuullisesti ja kestävästi. Olemme sitoutuneet ympäristöystävällisiin käytäntöihin ja yhteiskuntavastuuseen. Etsimme aktiivisesti tapoja pienentää oman toimintamme ympäristövaikutuksia. Haluamme tarjota turvallisen ja terveellisen työ- ja elinympäristön henkilöstöllemme, yhteistyökumppaneillemme, asiakkaillemme sekä muille sidosryhmillemme.

Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi on meille ensisijaisen tärkeää. Vaikka teemme ahkerasti hommia, pidämme huolta ihmisistämme ja heidän hyvinvoinnistaan. Panostamme työturvallisuuteen ja varmistamme, että työympäristömme on turvallinen kaikille. Tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut työhyvinvoinnin tueksi.

Vaalimme vahvaa yhteisöllisyyden kulttuuria. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ja tuemme toisiamme saavuttaaksemme yhteiset tavoitteet. Meillä on pitkiä työuria ja sitoutunut henkilöstö. Henkilöstökyselyssämme suositteluindeksimme (eNPS) on erinomaisella tasolla.

Rakennamme oppivaa organisaatiota. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa, joissa voit hyödyntää osaamistasi sekä kehittää uusia taitoja ja urapolkuasi haluamaasi suuntaan. Kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia jatkuvaan oppimiseen.

Lisätietoja meistä löydät täältä: Töihin YIT:lle | YITGROUP.COM

Hae 11.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, joten kannustamme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa työpäällikkö Max Kärnä, p. 050 357 7513.

YIT rakentaa vetovoimaisia elinympäristöjä Euroopassa. Rakennamme koteja hyvää elämää varten, tiloja, joissa ihmiset ja yritykset voivat menestyä sekä infrastruktuuria, joka varmistaa yhteiskunnan toimivuuden. Toimimme seitsemässä maassa ja työllistämme noin 4 100 ammattilaista. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 1,8 miljardia euroa. YIT Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingissä.

title: Head of Software Development
description:
Our client is a licensed Payment Service Provider (PSSP) and Microfinance Bank-backed fintech platform, delivering secure, fast, and reliable digital financial services. With advanced fraud detection, cutting-edge APIs, and multi-channel payment methods, our client powers consumers, merchants, and agents with wallets, payment gateways, and value-added services. The Head of Software Development will be the local execution leader responsible for turning the company's global technology vision into reality. The Head of Software Development will ensure the delivery, security, compliance, and scaling of our client's platforms in Nigeria, while reporting to the Chief Technical Consultant — the architect and custodian of the platform — as well as the company Board. This role requires a hands-on, highly technical leader with mastery of the company’s technology stack, security frameworks, and regulatory requirements, combined with the ability to build, mentor, and lead high-performing engineering teams locally.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Leadership & Execution
• Translate the consultant’s architecture into daily delivery and platform stability.
• Drive execution of the product and technology roadmap across fintech, wallets, and MFB integrations.
• Ensure platforms achieve regulatory-grade resilience, uptime, and scalability.

Engineering & Product Delivery
• Lead backend, frontend, mobile, and DevOps engineers locally.
• Deliver features including wallets, QR payments, card services, microloans, and merchant dashboards.
• Oversee integration with CBS, NIBSS, Interswitch, and card schemes (Visa, Verve, Mastercard).

Security, Compliance & Risk Management
• Enforce PCI-DSS Level 1, ISO 27001, and CBN/NIBSS regulatory compliance.
• Implement robust fraud prevention: AI-driven behavioural analytics, MFA, AML monitoring, and risk scoring.
• Ensure resilience through API security, error handling, and DDoS protection.

Infrastructure & Operations
• Manage cloud-native deployments (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring (ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
• Deliver high availability and disaster recovery capabilities.
• Maintain strong vendor/regulator relationships (cloud providers, auditors, CBN, NCC).

Team Leadership & Collaboration
• Recruit, mentor, and lead strong engineering and security teams locally.
• Drive agile methodologies and DevSecOps culture.
• Collaborate closely with the overseas consultant, ensuring architectural fidelity and safe code practices.


Requirements

Backend Development
• Languages: Java (Spring Boot), Node.js, Python, Go
• Frameworks: Spring Boot, Express.js
• APIs: RESTful & gRPC

Frontend & Mobile Development
• Frontend: React.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
• Mobile: Flutter, Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)

Messaging & AI/ML
• Messaging: Kafka (real-time streaming), RabbitMQ (message brokering)AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch (fraud detection); Spark ML, Kafka Streams (real-time analytics)

Security, Compliance & Fraud Prevention
• Standards: PCI-DSS Level 1, ISO 27001, SOC2, CBN compliance
• Encryption: AES-256, TLS 1.3, HSM (FIPS 140-2 certified), tokenization
• Fraud Prevention: MFA (biometrics, MPIN, device fingerprinting), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT authentication.
• Risk Mitigation: Rate limiting, DDoS protection (Cloudflare/Akamai WAF), AI-powered fraud detection

API Performance & Error Handling
• Redis caching, GraphQL, Gzip/Brotli compression
• Structured JSON error handling, retry mechanisms, circuit breaker pattern
• ELK Stack, Prometheus, AI-based anomaly detection
• Webhooks for async recovery & transaction notifications

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s preferred).
• 8–12+ years in senior technology roles.
• Strong background in fintech/payments/digital banking platforms.
• Proven ability to manage large-scale, high-availability systems with microservices architecture.
• Hands-on experience with full technology stack listed above.

title: Senior Associate (Finance and Projects – Energy & Natural Resources).
description:
Our client is a reputable legal firm delivering outstanding legal services to a broad range of companies, private clients, and governments. They are currently looking to hire a Senior Associate (Finance and Projects – Energy & Natural Resources).

Job Overview
The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, finance and energy lawyer with core transactional experience advising financial institutions, sponsors, investors, and corporates on complex financing, capital markets, and energy-related matters. The role requires hands-on involvement across structured finance, debt financing, project finance, mergers and acquisitions, and regulatory advisory work within the energy and natural resources sector.

The candidate must be capable of managing high-level transactions with limited supervision, engaging confidently with senior clients and stakeholders, supervising junior team members, and contributing meaningfully to the team’s commercial and strategic objectives.


Job Requirements
Minimum of 6 years post-call experience in the Energy and Natural Resources, Oil & Gas sector, with at least:
5 years in a law firm handling core transactional work within the sector.
1 year in a supervisory role, overseeing subordinates independently and managing stakeholders effectively.
Bachelor’s degree in law. Preferred Qualification: Master’s Degree in Law is an advantage
Mandatory experience in a commercial law firm.
Demonstrated ability to engage Partners, external clients, lenders, investors, and regulators.


Relevant Sector Exposure:
The candidate must have demonstrable transactional and advisory experience across finance, capital markets, and the energy and natural resources sector, including:
  • Asset-based lending and structured finance transactions
  • Receivables financing, supply chain finance, and title or consignment finance
  • Bilateral and syndicated debt financing
  • Acquisition finance, including public and private company acquisitions
  • Project finance and non-recourse financing structures
  • Capital markets transactions, including equity, debt, and structured products
  • Securitizations and asset-backed securities
  • Oil and gas and broader energy sector advisory work, including acquisitions and disposals,joint ventures, and joint operating agreements (JOAs)
  • Energy-related financings
  • Regulatory compliance and corporate governance related matters.
  • Experience managing transaction workstreams independently with limited supervision, including coordinating due diligence processes and preparing clear, commercially focused issues memos and reports. Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with clients, lenders, investors, regulators, and counterparties, and to contribute effectively to negotiations and stakeholder discussions. Experience supervising and mentoring junior team members is required.

Knowledge Requirements
The candidate must demonstrate hands-on expertise in the following areas:
  • Structured Finance and Lending: Practical knowledge of asset-based lending, receivables financing, supply chain finance, consignment and non-recourse financing structures, including documentation, security packages, and risk allocation.
  • Debt and Acquisition Finance: Strong understanding of bilateral and syndicated loan transactions, acquisition finance structures, refinancing arrangements, and financing of public and private company acquisitions, including MBOs and institutional buyouts.
  • Capital Markets and Securitization: Sound knowledge of equity and debt capital markets transactions, structured products, asset-backed securities, and securitization techniques, including exposure to project finance securitizations.
  • Energy and Natural Resources Transactions: In-depth understanding of oil and gas and broader energy sector transactions, including joint ventures, JOAs, energy-related financings, and commercial arrangements covering trading, transportation, storage, LNG, and supply.
  • Regulatory and Compliance Advisory: Strong knowledge of financial services regulation, licensing, corporate governance, and statutory compliance, including advisory on AML requirements, regulatory investigations, and engagement with sector regulators.
  • Due Diligence and Transaction Management: Expertise in managing legal due diligence processes, navigating physical and electronic data rooms, identifying transaction risks, and preparing comprehensive due diligence reports.
Core Skills & Competencies
  • Strategic Thinking & Commercial Acumen: Ability to analyze complex transactions, evaluate risks, and provide commercially sound legal advice.
  • Leadership & Influence: Proven capability to lead transaction, supervise and mentor junior lawyers, and collaborate across teams. Ability to advise clients and internal stakeholders on strategic and regulatory matters.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal, and written skills for drafting complex agreements, legal opinions, proposals, reports, and client communications.
  • Project & Transaction Management: Proficient in managing multiple high-value and cross-border transactions under tight deadlines. Skilled in due diligence coordination, issue identification, and report preparation.
  • Confidentiality & Professional Integrity: Ability to handle sensitive client information and documents discreetly
  • Adaptability: Flexible and resilient in fast-paced, high-performance environments.
  • Tech Fluency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, document management systems, and legal research platforms.

description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Staff, Strategic Finance Systems Manager – Order to Cash is a hands-on subject-matter expert responsible for operating, enhancing, and supporting enterprise receivables and collections capabilities across Oracle Cloud ERP (Accounts Receivable) and GetPaid. This role combines strong finance and accounting fundamentals with deep system expertise to enable accurate credit management, billing, cash application, collections, and dispute and deduction resolution.

You will work directly with business partners and finance stakeholders across the order-to-cash cycle while also performing light system configuration, data validation, and process support across credit, billing, cash application, collections, deductions, and related domains.

Responsibilities :

Order-to-Cash Operations: Credit, Collections & Cash Application

  • Support end-to-end order-to-cash processes — credit review, invoicing and billing, cash application, collections, and dispute and deduction resolution — within Oracle Cloud ERP (AR) and GetPaid, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Maintain and enhance receivables processes and rules supporting credit scoring and limits, collections and dunning strategies, cash-application matching, and deduction handling.
  • Apply strong finance and accounting principles to validate AR balances, reconcile cash application, and support accurate aging and receivables reporting.

Hands-On System Configuration & Model Support

  • Perform light system configuration within Oracle ERP AR and GetPaid, including customer and credit master updates, collections and dunning strategy setup, cash-application matching rules, and dispute and deduction reason codes.
  • Support configuration and ongoing operation of receivables modules such as credit management, collections worklists, cash application, and deductions.
  • Partner with Finance Systems or Engineering teams on larger enhancements, testing, and deployments.

Business Partnership & Order-to-Cash Engagement

  • Engage directly with business and finance partners to understand credit policy, collections priorities, billing requirements, and dispute-resolution needs.
  • Translate business needs into system-enabled receivables solutions, balancing customer experience, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Communicate receivables insights, DSO and collections trends, and tradeoffs clearly to drive alignment and informed decision-making.

Execution & Independent Ownership

  • Independently drive receivables workstreams, system improvements, and operational processes using a metrics-oriented approach (DSO, Collections Effectiveness Index, unapplied cash, dispute cycle time).
  • Serve as a go-to resource for complex questions related to Oracle ERP AR and GetPaid functionality, credit and collections logic, and cash-application behavior.
  • Identify issues proactively and recommend solutions grounded in both financial insight and system understanding.

Product-Oriented Mindset

  • Act as a functional product owner for order-to-cash system capabilities, supporting backlog prioritization, requirements definition, and solution testing.
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions for credit, collections, cash-application, and deductions enhancements, informed by user feedback and system constraints.

Culture & Collaboration

  • Collaborate effectively across Strategic Finance, Controllership, Order Management, Systems, and Data teams.
  • Share knowledge, contribute to documentation and best practices, and support continuous improvement in receivables operations.

Basic Qualifications :

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field AND 10+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, finance accounting, order-to-cash, or related roles, OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience in receivables accounting, credit, collections, and cash application.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP (Accounts Receivable) and/or GetPaid, including credit, collections, cash application, and/or deductions use cases.
  • Ability to work independently on complex analyses and system-enabled receivables processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience configuring or supporting credit management, collections, cash application, and deductions in Oracle ERP or GetPaid.
  • Experience supporting billing and invoicing and revenue-adjacent activities within the order-to-cash cycle.
  • Prior experience in a functional product manager or product owner role for finance systems.
  • Experience partnering directly with business teams during credit, collections, and dispute-resolution cycles.

Suggested Skills:

  • Order-to-Cash (O2C)
  • Oracle Cloud ERP
  • Credit & Collections Management

The Project Planning & Production Control Lead is responsible for developing and managing project and production
schedules to ensure on-time delivery of customer orders. The role works closely with Engineering, Supply Chain,
Production, and other cross-functional teams to align material availability, manufacturing capacity, and project
milestones.The position plays a critical role in capacity planning, resource optimization and production scheduling.

stakeholders.

title: Program Director
description:
Our client, a leading NGO with the aim to drive research and advance the work done by Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) and its Stakeholders across Africa seeks to hire a Program Director who will lead their efforts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and guiding the strategic vision of our client and managing internal and external stakeholder relationships. The Program Director’s ultimate mission is to build a strong continent- wide network that ultimately changes the way in which researchers and practitioners in Civil Society engage meaningfully in Africa, making Civil Society relevant in Africa’s Development.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
  • PROGRAMS: Design programs and events that are aligned with the organizational areas, and manage them through planning, documentation, and execution across the continent. The deliverables expected from handling programs will be Research & Publications, Annual Conference, Capacity Building and Events/Programs.

  • RESEARCH: Support members in their research activities, identify funding opportunities and build partnerships with research institutes, and build strong training initiatives to improve members’ research capacity.

  • FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION: Oversee financial management; ensure that funds are used efficiently, and reporting is done properly, with particular attention to reporting to the organization’s advisory board. The deliverables for overseeing the finances and administration will be Finance & Accounting, Operations/Logistics, Record keeping and General Administration.

  • FUNDRAISING: Align strategic program needs with forecasting and budgeting and set annual fundraising targets.

  • EXTERNAL RELATIONS: Serve as the key spokesperson for the organization, articulate its values and mission with various audiences, and sustain aggressive membership-expansion strategies, with annual targets for both institutional and individual memberships. The deliverables for external relations are Membership, Partnership-Building, Public Relations and Funding & Mentoring Partner Relationships.

  • ORGANIZATIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Recruit and retain the best people and develop a healthy work environment to promote staff growth, well-being, and productivity.

Requirements


• At least a postgraduate degree in the social sciences (preferably, a PhD).
• At least 6 years of relevant/related work experience in a managerial capacity. Experience spanning various sectors is highly desirable.
• Must recognize the multiple contexts in Africa, appreciate the changing dynamics and leverage diversity, building bridges across regions, academia and practice.
• Experience in partnership building on a multi-national level is essential.
• Must be able to manage the organization with the future in mind and anticipating contextual changes that may affect the vision and strategy.
• Must demonstrate strong interpersonal skills in both informal and formal settings and must be able to engage effectively with multiple audiences for mutual benefit.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Graphic Designer based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to shape compelling visual experiences across PR, social media, revenue, and events.
You will create high-quality digital and print assets that strengthen brand presence across multiple touchpoints.
The position combines hands-on design execution with opportunities to contribute to broader visual identity systems.
You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn ideas, campaigns, and business needs into polished creative work.
The environment is fast-paced, international, and highly collaborative, with multiple projects and brands in motion.
You’ll have meaningful ownership of creative projects while working alongside experienced communications, marketing, and design professionals.
This is an ideal opportunity for a versatile designer who enjoys balancing creativity, consistency, and commercial impact.

Accountabilities

  • Design engaging social media graphics, carousels, event visuals, and digital marketing assets across a range of campaigns and initiatives.
  • Create and maintain pitch decks, presentations, one-pagers, case studies, and sales collateral using Figma.
  • Develop event materials such as banners, signage, booth graphics, merchandise, and printed collateral.
  • Develop creative concepts that align with established client and internal brand guidelines while bringing fresh visual ideas to projects.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve visual identity systems to ensure consistency across digital and physical touchpoints.
  • Collaborate closely with PR, social media, revenue, events, and other teams to understand creative requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Prepare artwork for both digital publication and professional print production, ensuring files meet technical specifications.
  • Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously, prioritize competing requests, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Organize and maintain design files, templates, libraries, and brand assets so they remain accessible and consistent.
  • Contribute creative expertise to projects spanning emerging technology, fintech, B2B, and other innovative industries.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience within an agency or in-house creative environment.
    • A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality digital and print design across varied formats and creative applications.
    • Advanced proficiency with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign.
    • Proven experience designing presentations, marketing collateral, social media assets, event materials, and other branded communications.
    • Strong understanding of typography, composition, layout, color, visual hierarchy, and overall design principles.
    • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and file-management skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently while incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders.
    • Nice to have: Experience with motion graphics or animation using After Effects.
    • Nice to have: Experience designing for B2B, technology, fintech, or crypto brands.
    • Nice to have: Familiarity with AI-powered design tools.
    • Nice to have: Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS for digital assets.

      • Benefits

      • Compensation: $2,000–$3,000 USD, depending on experience.
      • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
      • Global environment: Collaborate with an international team across communications, PR, marketing, events, and creative functions.
      • Creative exposure: Work on projects for innovative companies across crypto, fintech, emerging technology, and related industries.
      • High-impact work: Take ownership of creative projects that contribute directly to brand visibility and business growth.
      • Professional development: Collaborate with experienced creative and communications professionals while expanding your design expertise.
      • Portfolio growth: Build a diverse body of work across digital campaigns, presentations, events, social media, print, and brand identity.
      • Ownership and variety: Help shape visual identities across multiple brands while contributing to the evolution of the internal creative function.

title: FQI Technician 1
description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Final Quality Inspection (FQI) technician works under general direction, follows oral and/or written instruction and performs Inspection and testing processes to produce tested electro-mechanical assemblies, sub-assemblies and accessories. This position requires a highly-motivated team player to support quality screening for surgical robotic systems, instruments and accessories by simulating customer use, identify potential quality issues and working cross functionally with manufacturing and quality engineering teams to correct and verify issues prior to product release.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Follows all applicable work instructions to perform simulated surgical procedures utilizing a surgical robotic system and accessories.
  • Performing inspections at random to assess product quality.
  • Measure objects comparing to their intended physical specifications, perform quality tests and identifying defects.
  • Recording inspection results inputting data into quality database.
  • Communicate and troubleshoot product non-conformances to Manufacturing and Quality Engineering (QE).
  • Follows all corporate, safety, production procedures and regulations
  • Maintains a clean and orderly workstation.
  • Maintains an excellent attendance record in compliance with established manufacturing and quality attendance guidelines.
  • Verify kanban levels for consumables and supplements for FQI.
  • Create quality notifications as NCR and EE.
  • Provide support required to maintain line running.
  • Operate and set up (as needed), test equipment/fixtures.
  • Support for the engineering team with tests or special requirements during investigations for quality events.
  • Maintain ISU records on time.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

  • Must be able to complete training and certification on Final Quality Inspection procedures.
  • Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Language Skills: Basic ability to read, write and understand English on day-to-day activities (25%). Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos preferred.
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide. Ability to determine the minimum, maximum and nominal value when provided with a specification and a tolerance.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions. Ability to deal with situations including up to several variables. Ability to report actual or potential quality issues. Ability to suggest simple process improvements.
  • Computer skills: Proficient in use of personal computers as part of daily work, including knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite and e-mail, SAP (or similar) to perform multiple inspection transactions.
  • Other skills and abilities preferred: Ability to work varying shifts. Must have ability to complete training courses. Ability to work in a team environment. Ability to use clocks, timers, calipers, voltmeters, power supplies, rulers, and other test equipment as required. Meticulous attention to detail and orderly habits are required to accurately and completely document testing. Flexibility, willingness to learn new tasks, ability to take-on a variety of responsibilities big and small, and the need to fill-in for others when needed are highly preferred attributes for this position.

title: Area Supervisor
description:
The Area Supervisor manages daily delivery operations, rider teams, and vendor
performance across an assigned district. This role is responsible for keeping delivery speeds
high (SLA), keeping costs under control, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations across
dark stores and partner hubs through on-ground presence, performance tracking, and vendor
coordination.
Key Responsibilities:

1. Daily Operations & Vendor Management:

  • Live Fleet Oversight: Track real-time zone operations to make sure riders hit target delivery times, maintain high customer ratings, and keep order cancellations to a minimum.
  • Driver Performance: Keep close tabs on rider metrics to spot bottlenecks early and keep order dispatch running efficiently.
  • Vendor & 3PL Coordination: Work directly with 3PL providers and fleet vendors to evaluate their performance, address service gaps, and scale up rider supply during rush hours or demand spikes.
  • Process Improvement: Work alongside the central Operations team to tweak daily workflows and fix recurring operational issues on the ground.

2. Performance Tracking & Analytics:

  • KPI Management: Monitor daily operational metrics, focusing on On-Time Delivery Rate, Orders Per Hour (OPH), and Delivery Cost Per Order.
  • Reporting: Build regular tracking reports using Microsoft Excel (utilizing Pivot Tables, data filters, and formulas) to present clear performance trends and updates to leadership.
  • Problem Solving: Run quick root-cause checks whenever KPIs drop below target and put immediate fixes in place.

3. Field Audits, Quality & Onboarding:

  • On-Ground Audits: Conduct routine site visits alongside Team Leaders across partner locations to inspect rider attendance, uniform compliance, gear condition, and overall professional behavior.
  • Quality Control: Partner with the QA team to resolve functional app issues, handle rider misconduct, and enforce service standards across the fleet.
  • Rider Training: Help onboard and train new drivers on app navigation, route efficiency, customer interaction standards, and road safety protocols..

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations Management or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in Fleet Operations, E-commerce, Grocery, or Marketplace.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into business decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI is a plus.
  • Excellent English.
  • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Excellent ability to be detail oriented.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment by collaborating with other departments.
  • Strong ability to multitask.

title: Content Experience Specialist — Medical Device (Hybrid — Arbor Lakes, MN) Contract

Our F500 Medical Device client has an exciting opportunity for a Content Experience Specialist.

Our client is seeking a Content Experience Specialist, who is passionate about creating innovative, compelling, and motivating customer-centric content experiences. This role represents an exciting opportunity to initiate, develop, and execute meaningful content experiences that engage and motivate existing physicians and other healthcare professionals (HCPs).


The Content Experience Specialist will plan, develop, and execute physician-facing content and integrated communications plans that drive the marketing and communications objectives. They will become familiar with key audience insights and build relevant communications that capture their attention and motivate them to enrich their understanding of our offering and accelerate adoption.


This individual should have a take-charge spirit to collaborate cross-functionally and translate business and marketing objectives into effective communication and measurable content strategies across a wide array of digital channels.


Additionally, this role will work closely with Digital Marketing, Product Marketing, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure the content aligns to channel best practices and to drive consistent implementation of optimization recommendations.


This is a role for a results-focused individual contributor who can think strategically but also drive superb execution


Qualified candidates are fluent in today’s digital marketing ecosystem and how to apply it to content development. Key areas include, but are not limited to, website, email, programmatic advertising, organic/paid social, marketing automation, and other levers and capabilities within an omnichannel marketing program.

  • Build and manage cross-functional relationships with Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Design, Marketing Automation, IT, and other relevant teams.

  • Ensure content is consistent with the client’s established guidelines, processes, and tools. Provide recommendations where appropriate.

  • Communicate proactively to all stakeholders, managing expectations, timelines, and logistics.

  • Acquire and maintain knowledge of communications and industry trends and best-in-class practices related to responsibilities. Share learnings with an internal team where appropriate.

  • Serve as a thought leader by sharing knowledge and best practices with team and cross-functional stakeholders.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, Communications, English, Journalism, or another relevant field, or commensurate work experience

  • 5+ years of content strategy and/or marketing campaign experience in med device, pharma, biotech, consumer healthcare or other regulated healthcare environments

  • • Similar experience in creative services, consulting, product, or strategic marketing are also acceptable proxies

  • Experience developing content and materials from concept through production for use in multiple channels, with a heavy concentration on digital storytelling and asset creation; some copywriting experience is required

  • Understanding of brand management and principles

  • Experience working with and managing agency and external vendor partners

  • Highly motivated, action-oriented with demonstrated ability to lead, collaborate, influence within a team-based environment and partner with internal/external stakeholders

  • Strong interpersonal skills, both verbal and written, including developing relationships with internal and external partners and leadership, along with direct and indirect influencing to drive business objectives

  • Strong attention to detail, good adaptability, and ability to manage and progress projects through completion

  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, programs and adapt to changing priorities

title: Regional Revenue Lead
description:

title: Lead Email Designer for a US Retention Agency (LATAM/Remote)
description:
Lead Email Designer

Remote. Full-time. Latin America.

Role is for a performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

We are hiring the person who owns email design quality across the agency, and we are hiring in Latin America because the work runs on US hours and the talent here is better than the market pays for.

This is a player-coach seat. You set the first designs for every new client yourself. You build the visual system they will live in: type, photography treatment, merchandising, campaign worlds. Then you lead the graphic designers who execute against that system, and you hold the bar on everything that leaves the agency.

If you have only ever executed someone else's art direction, or only designed for one brand in-house, this is not the role.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Hours

You hold 9am to 5pm EST every working day. The rest of your day is yours to shape. Mexico City is EST minus 1, Bogotá is EST, Buenos Aires and São Paulo are EST plus 2. If you are not willing to protect that window, do not apply.

Requirements

    • You have worked at an agency that services 9-figure ecommerce / DTC brands. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
    • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
    • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.
    • You have led designers before. Small team is fine. You know how to brief, redline, and get better work out of other people without sanding it down to safe.
    • Mastery of Figma. Adobe is assumed. You can build for Klaviyo without designing like Klaviyo.
    • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.
    • Professional written and spoken English. You will run critique with US strategists and copywriters.
    • Based in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, or Costa Rica, and able to work 9am to 1pm EST.
  • Send a portfolio link with your application. Applications without a book that shows email work go straight to the bottom of the pile. If your email work is under NDA, send the closest editorial or campaign work you can share and say so.

Benefits

PTO

Performance Bonuses

Paid in USD

Fully remote, permanently

title: Full Stack AI Engineer - barcelona
description:
At Indeep AI, we are an applied AI research laboratory working at the intersection of natural language processing, linguistics, and human cognition. Our work is grounded in a simple conviction: the tools we use to write and understand documents should make communication clearer and more trustworthy, not less. That research powers Typewiser, our document intelligence platform. Typewiser helps people produce and understand high-stakes documents with greater clarity and rigour, analysing how information is communicated, surfacing where meaning breaks down, and supporting the writer in real time. It is backed by European research funding and built on peer-reviewed scientific foundations. We are a small, multidisciplinary team of linguists, engineers, scientists, and operators. We are at the stage where the way we present ourselves to the world is still being built. That is where you come in.


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack AI Engineer to join our team at Indeep Artificial Intelligence (IAI) at our office in Barcelona. We need someone who can support our technical efforts across the board. Working closely with and directly supporting our CTO, you will move fluidly across the whole stack — from backend and platform engineering, to the LLM and AI pipelines at the core of our product, to the infrastructure that runs it, to the frontend that users touch. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who is happiest when they can pick up almost any part of the system and make progress on it. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer. We need a strong generalist: someone who can context-switch, learn quickly, and be trusted to deliver across whatever the week demands. You won’t own the architecture, but you will be the person who helps turn it into working, reliable software, and your judgement will carry real weight.


We need someone with a strong startup attitude: sharp problem-solving skills, the ability to manage priorities and deliverables autonomously without rigid timeframes, and the capacity to handle diverse task assignments. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast without sacrificing quality, and can pivot when priorities shift, you’re exactly who we’re looking for. This role is for someone energised by wearing multiple hats and making an impact without needing a detailed playbook. If that sounds like you, we’d be excited to hear from you.


  • Contract Type: Permanent
  • Full Office-Based Work Modality: Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 at WeWork Glòries Barcelona


Duties & Responsibilities


Backend & Platform Engineering


  • Build, extend, and maintain the backend services and platform logic that power Typewiser.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and contribute to the overall health of the codebase.
  • Implement features end-to-end, from data layer through to API, in collaboration with the CTO.


LLM & AI Pipeline Work


  • Develop and integrate the LLM-driven pipelines at the core of the product, including prompting strategies, orchestration, structured outputs, and RAG and validation layers.
  • Integrate and evaluate third-party AI models and APIs, balancing quality, latency, and cost.
  • Help build the tooling and evaluation needed to keep AI-driven features reliable and reproducible.


Infrastructure & Deployment


  • Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
  • Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.


Frontend & Full-Stack


  • Contribute to the frontend and deliver full-stack features as needed, ensuring a coherent experience from interface to backend.
  • Collaborate on the product’s UI where engineering and design meet.


Qualifications Required:


  • 5 to 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python (our primary backend language).
  • Hands-on experience integrating and working with LLMs or other AI/ML models in production, including prompt engineering.
  • Working experience with frontend development and modern web frameworks.
  • Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
  • A genuine generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem across the entire stack rather than a single layer.
  • C1-level proficiency in English.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup/scale-up environment and understand the specific challenges of early-stage companies.


Preferred:


  • Experience with AWS.
  • Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM evaluation.
  • Experience in an early-stage startup, owning broad surface area with limited support.
  • Exposure to NLP or document-processing systems.
  • Working proficiency in other EU languages, particularly Spanish and Italian.


What We Offer


  • €50,000–€80,000 yearly gross salary depending on demonstrable experience and breadth of skills.
  • A high-impact engineering role with broad ownership across the entire stack of a live AI product.
  • Close, direct collaboration with the CTO and visibility across the whole company.
  • Early-stage team member at a high-potential EIC-funded startup.


How to Apply


To apply, send your CV through LinkedIn along with links to work we can look at — a portfolio, GitHub, or projects you’ve shipped. We’re less interested in a cover letter than in seeing what you’ve actually built and how you approach problems across the stack. A short note on a project you’re proud of and your role in it is welcome. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so don’t wait to apply.

Why Join Smiths Detection?

  • Work with industry-leading technology and digital learning solutions.
  • Influence the development of new products and training programmes.
  • Collaborate with global customers and stakeholders.

title: Consultant – Anesthesia and Pain Management
description:
Black Pearl is recruiting on behalf of a well-established healthcare provider in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Lead specialist pain assessment and interventional pain-management services for patients with acute, chronic and complex pain conditions. The successful physician will combine excellent clinical judgment with compassionate communication, multidisciplinary teamwork and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.

Key responsibilities

· Conduct comprehensive pain assessments and develop evidence-based pharmacological, interventional and multidisciplinary treatment plans.

· Perform fluoroscopy- and ultrasound-guided pain procedures within approved privileges.

· Manage neuropathic, musculoskeletal, cancer-related and post-surgical pain in collaboration with relevant specialties.

· Review outcomes, medication safety, opioid stewardship and procedural complications.

· Contribute to pain-service pathways, education, governance, audit and appropriate anesthesia/on-call duties.

· Provide safe, evidence-based, patient- and family-centered consultant care in accordance with professional standards, hospital policies and approved clinical privileges.

· Supervise junior medical staff, support multidisciplinary decision-making and promote effective communication with patients and families.

· Participate in clinical governance, incident review, quality improvement, credentialing, continuing professional development and departmental education.

· Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and comply with infection prevention, medication safety, privacy and regulatory requirements.



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

Education and specialist qualifications

· Medical degree, recognized Anesthesiology specialty qualification, and recognized Pain Medicine fellowship/board sufficient for the DOH Pain Management title.

· The exact specialty and subspecialty award must be recognized under the current UAE Professional Qualification Requirements and support the requested Consultant title.

· Completion of internship and active, unrestricted professional registration/licensure in the current or most recent country of practice.

Experience and licensing

· Consultant-level experience meeting current DOH requirements, with recent and substantial interventional pain practice.

· Candidates must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Department of Health – Abu Dhabi Consultant licence for the applicable base specialty/title.

· Applicants must demonstrate recent clinical activity, competence within the advertised scope and no unresolved licensing, credentialing or professional-standing concerns.

· For Tier 1 vacancies, the exact Tier 1 award is mandatory. As a general screening guide, the Consultant route normally requires at least two years after the main specialty award or one year after a recognized subspecialty award, subject to DOH assessment.

Role-specific requirements

· A current transferable DOH licence, or formal DOH eligibility, specifically in Pain Management is strongly required.

· Current BLS and ACLS.

· Detailed interventional pain procedure logbook and image-guided intervention training.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

Documents required with the application

· Updated, detailed CV showing month/year dates, hospital, country, job title, specialty scope and any career gaps.

· Valid passport copy and recent professional photograph.

· Primary medical degree, internship certificate, main specialty board/certificate and relevant subspecialty fellowship/board.

· Current and previous medical licences/registrations and a recent Good Standing Certificate.

· Employer experience certificates confirming exact dates, title, specialty and full-time clinical service.

· Current BLS/ACLS/PALS and other role-specific certificates, as applicable.

· Procedure/case logbook and current privilege list for surgical, procedural or technology-dependent roles.

· Existing DataFlow/PSV report or UIN and DOH eligibility/licence, if already available.

· Contact details for two or three recent clinical referees, preferably a Department Chair, Medical Director or direct Consultant supervisor.

How to apply

Submit your updated CV and supporting credentials through the Black Pearl website. description:

Description

Service Technician

New York City/Long Island

Lacas Coffee Company (“Lacas” or the “Company”), a growing midsized regional coffee roaster based in Pennsauken New Jersey, is looking to hire a Service Technician. A Service Technician at Lacas is responsible for installing and deinstalling coffee and espresso brewing equipment at customer locations, and repairing and refurbishing used equipment to be placed into service. Customer locations include, but are not limited to, restaurants, diners, bagel stores, colleges, hotels, and other away-from-home locations where coffee beverages are prepared. Service Technicians are also responsible for maintaining adequate and accurate parts inventory, service call closure and specific documentation of work assignments and time. Work hours are Monday through Friday, during the day. Periodic compensated weekend on-call work is required.

Responsibilities

  • Install, repair and remove specified coffee and beverage dispensing equipment in a designated regional geography.
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled service activities including emergency service calls, preventative maintenance, surveys and installations
  • Required to participate in "On Call" service including after hours and weekend schedule rotation
  • Maintain spare part levels and reorders within replenishment guidelines
  • Responsible for all documentation and activity verification required by the Company, including call closure procedure, completeness of invoice, and signature of all required documents from the customer.
  • Participate in the forecasting and planning of equipment needs.
  • Provide customer feedback/requests to management or to other departments.
  • Create a system to fulfill all promises made to customers.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive hourly compensation, based on experience. Full suite of benefits available, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid holidays and time-off.

About Lacas Coffee Company

Celebrating our Centennial in 2021, Lacas Coffee is one of the nation's longest established independent coffee roasters. We have been selecting and importing only the highest quality new crop Arabica beans from family owned plantations throughout the world’s coffee growing regions. Our Original Blends, Specialty, Organic, and Fair Trade coffees are custom roasted at our state of the art facility and delivered fresh to demanding distributors, restaurants, hotels, specialty coffee shops and retailers through a network of regional and national distributors in a variety of channels. We continue to personally inspect and sample every batch of coffee beans we import and we select only those beans which meet the highest standards of quality and consistency. title: HSE Supervisor datakeskus ja teollisuusrakentamisen hankkeille
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa vastuullista ja kestävää infrastruktuuria?

Etsimme HSE Supervisoria työturvallisuustiimiin datakeskus ja teollisuusrakentamisen hankkeille. Digitaalisen infran sekä energia- ja teollisuusrakentamisen liiketoiminta toteuttaa vaativia teollisuushankkeita, energialaitoksia ja datakeskuksia. Meillä pääset mukaan rakentamaan uutta, strategisesti tärkeää liiketoiminta-aluetta.

Työturvallisuustiimin HSE Supervisorina vastaat työmaan työturvallisuuden käytännön johtamisesta ja varmistat, että turvallisuusasiat toteutuvat arjessa suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Olet tärkeä osa työturvallisuustiimiä, koordinoit päivittäistä turvallisuustyötä ja huolehdit sujuvasta tiedonkulusta työmaan eri osapuolten välillä.

Tehtävässä toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä työpäällikön, vastaavan työnjohtajan, muun työnjohdon, työntekijöiden, aliurakoitsijoiden sekä tilaajan kanssa. Varmistat omalta osaltasi, että turvallisuusohjeet ja -käytännöt ovat selkeitä ja että niitä noudatetaan kaikissa työvaiheissa.

Vastuullasi on työmaan turvallisuussuunnitelmien käytännön jalkauttaminen, työvaihekohtaisten turvallisuusratkaisujen ohjaus sekä riskien ennakointi. Organisoit tarkastuksia, seuraat turvallisuushavaintoja ja puutut aktiivisesti poikkeamiin. Lisäksi osallistut perehdytyksiin ja koulutuksiin sekä varmistat, että työmaa toimii lakien, määräysten ja tilaajan vaatimusten mukaisesti. Toimit keskeisenä linkkinä työturvallisuuskulttuurin kehittämisessä ja huolehdit siitä, että turvallisuus on näkyvä ja kiinteä osa jokapäiväistä työskentelyä työmaalla. HSE Supervisorin rooliin kuuluu myös perehdytysten toteuttaminen sekä muita työmaa-alueen turvallisuuteen liittyviä tehtäviä.

Miksi YIT:lle?

Tapamme toimia pohjautuu arvoihimme: arvostus, yhteistyö, luovuus ja intohimo. Ne ohjaavat meitä päivittäisessä työssämme menestymään yhdessä, luomaan uutta ja toimimaan eettisesti, kestävästi ja laadukkaasti. YIT:llä olemme sitoutuneet neljään kulttuurin kulmakiveen: asiakaslähtöinen, korkea suorituskyky, oppiva ja inhimillinen. Ymmärrämme asiakkaidemme tarpeet ja kehitämme liiketoimintaamme yhdessä heidän kanssaan. Asetamme riman korkealle kaikessa mitä teemme, johtaen tiedolla ja esimerkillä. Haluamme jatkuvasti parantaa osaamistamme ja kehittyä. Inhimillisyys näkyy meillä turvallisuudessa, henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnissa ja erinomaisena ihmisten johtamisena.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Oikeanlaista asennetta ja motivaatiota kehittää työmaan turvallisuutta sekä henkilöstön turvallisuusosaamista
  • Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. rakennus-, turvallisuus- tai tekniikan ala; AMK, teknillinen koulu tai vastaava)
  • Kokemusta työmaan turvallisuustehtävistä, työnjohdosta tai vastaavista rooleista
  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito kirjallisesti ja suullisesti
  • Valmius liikkua työmaiden sijainnin mukaan
  • Valmius suorittaa YIT:n järjestämä sisäinen Työturvallisuuden johtamisen valmennus (5 vuoden välein)

Mitä voit odottaa meiltä?

Toimimme vastuullisesti ja kestävästi. Olemme sitoutuneet ympäristöystävällisiin käytäntöihin ja yhteiskuntavastuuseen. Etsimme aktiivisesti tapoja pienentää oman toimintamme ympäristövaikutuksia. Haluamme tarjota turvallisen ja terveellisen työ- ja elinympäristön henkilöstöllemme, yhteistyökumppaneillemme, asiakkaillemme sekä muille sidosryhmillemme.

Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi on meille ensisijaisen tärkeää. Vaikka teemme ahkerasti hommia, pidämme huolta ihmisistämme ja heidän hyvinvoinnistaan. Panostamme työturvallisuuteen ja varmistamme, että työympäristömme on turvallinen kaikille. Tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut työhyvinvoinnin tueksi.

Vaalimme vahvaa yhteisöllisyyden kulttuuria. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ja tuemme toisiamme saavuttaaksemme yhteiset tavoitteet. Meillä on pitkiä työuria ja sitoutunut henkilöstö. Henkilöstökyselyssämme suositteluindeksimme (eNPS) on erinomaisella tasolla.

Rakennamme oppivaa organisaatiota. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa, joissa voit hyödyntää osaamistasi sekä kehittää uusia taitoja ja urapolkuasi haluamaasi suuntaan. Kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia jatkuvaan oppimiseen.

Lisätietoja meistä löydät täältä: Töihin YIT:lle | YITGROUP.COM

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae paikkaa mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 30.9.2026 mennessä. Tehtäviä on avoinna useita, ja täytämme paikkoja jo hakuprosessin edetessä.

Tehtävästä lisätietoja antaa HSE Manager Tapio Väänänen, p. 050 440 2654 ja

Tuotantopäällikkö, Juuso Rapeli, p. 040 764 4349.

Rakennamme ja kehitämme kestäviä elinympäristöjä: toimivia ja viihtyisiä koteja asumiseen, julkisia ja kaupallisia rakennuksia tulevaisuuden tarpeisiin, infrastruktuuria vihreän siirtymän edistämiseksi sekä teollisuus-, tuotanto- ja energialaitoksia asiakkaidemme prosessien tueksi. YIT:n visiona on olla osaavin kumppani kestävien kotien, tilojen ja kaupunkien kehittämisessä - hyvää elämää varten. Tiimiimme kuuluu noin 4 100 ammattilaista ja vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,8 miljardia euroa. YIT:n osake on listattuna Nasdaq Helsingissä.

This requires a strong understanding of the inputs and outputs within a custom SQL database and VB.NET based platform, with the goal of optimizing how teams interact with backend and frontend systems to reduce redundant data entry, minimize errors, and improve data consistency across the organization. This position will collaborate cross-functionally and lead initiatives that streamline data flows, strengthen data integrity, and enable scalable, automated content generation.

  • Experience working with Big Data frameworks and distributed file systems (such as Apache Spark and Hadoop/HDFS), including building and optimizing scalable data pipelines, leveraging distributed storage and parallel processing, and ensuring performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in large-scale data environments.
  • Ability to program independently in languages such as R or Python, particularly for data manipulation, analysis, and scripting automation.
  • Experience building and managing data solutions on major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google), including data integration, databases, data lakes, and virtual compute infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with distributed file systems and processing frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop to build scalable, high-performance data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI) for workflow automation and low-code solution development.

  • Ability to integrate, manage, and harmonize diverse and complex data sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency across systems.
  • Experience contributing to full software or solution lifecycles, from concept and design through development, implementation, and maintenance.
  • Familiarity with technical writing principles or interest in automating and enhancing the generation of technical product content.
  • Self-directed, detail-oriented problem solver with strong analytical thinking and initiative.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts or schema into clear, understandable terms across broad audiences.
  • Experience with Agile design approaches and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of basic scientific principles in biology and chemistry and/or experience working closely with scientists on data analysis or data pipeline projects (Familiarity with flow cytometry principles is a plus)

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Master of Science degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Software Engineering or related technical discipline.

title: Insurance Verification Lead - Eagle or Summit County, CO
description:
ABOUT THE JOB:

The Insurance Verification Lead oversees front-end revenue cycle workflows that occur prior to claim submission, including insurance verification, coordination of benefits (COB), registration accuracy, financial clearance, and point-of-service collections.

This role provides oversight, standardization, training, auditing, and accountability for front-end operational workflows across VSON locations. While the position may provide occasional operational coverage, the primary focus is process ownership, workflow improvement, staff development, performance monitoring, and ensuring accurate patient intake and financial clearance processes.

The role works closely with front desk teams, operational leadership, billing partners, and clinical departments to support clean claims, reduce preventable denials, and improve patient financial workflows.


This is a full-time, Monday through Friday position from 8a -5p with a 1 hour lunch. This role can sit in our Edwards, Vail, or Frisco offices with an opportunity for some hybrid work when trained. This role will require travel to all VSON clinics and will receive paid mileage.

Priority will be given to applicants who already live in Eagle or Summit County, Colorado.

This role is eligible for Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits, employer-paid long-term disability and life insurance, an extensive PTO program, continuing education, birthday time off, 401K and profit sharing, and is eligible for the company's monthly bonus program.


This role will be open until September 1, 2026 or until filled.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Patient Registration & Insurance Capture

  • Establish and maintain patient registration accuracy standards across all locations.
  • Set and maintain clear standards for insurance card capture, insurance entry into eCW, and insurer selection.
  • Conduct ongoing training and accountability follow-up with front desk staff on registration standards.
  • Perform monthly front-end quality audits; use denial data from Synergen to identify patterns and target training.
  • Track and report front-end error rates; set reduction targets and monitor progress.

Eligibility Verification & COB Management

  • Oversee and standardize eligibility verification workflows to ensure coverage is verified prior to service.
  • Develop and implement a COB correction and resolution workflow, including real-time fixes and post-denial feedback loops.
  • Translate denial trend data from Synergen into specific front-end training actions with clear timelines.

Prior Authorization & Referral Management

  • Collaborate with the authorization team to ensure front-end workflows support timely and accurate authorization processing.
  • Verify therapy benefits and authorization units upfront for all therapy patients, including unit limits, applicable dates of service, and plan limits.
  • Monitor validity of existing authorizations covering continuous services (physical therapy, routine injections).
  • Manage referral requirements by payer; ensure referring provider information is complete and accurate at scheduling.

Patient Financial Clearance & POS Collections

  • Own the patient estimate and financial clearance process prior to service.
  • Monitor and improve point-of-service collection workflows, training, and performance metrics.
  • Manage hospital discounted care workflows as appropriate.
  • Support Synergen on unresolved patient AR issues where front-end information is needed.

Operational Liaison & Scheduling Alignment

  • Serve as the liaison between clinical operations and billing for front-end workflow changes — especially when payer rules change.
  • Ensure scheduling rules and patient access workflows support clean intake.

Reporting & Feedback Loop

  • • Review Synergen’s monthly front-end performance summary and implement corrective actions, workflow improvements, and staff training as needed.
  • Participate in the weekly RCM operating review; report on front-end metrics and action items.
  • Escalate persistent front-end issues to the RCM Leader and operations leadership with specific corrective action recommendations.

title: Quality Culture Program Lead — Pharmaceutical (Hybrid — Indianapolis, IN) Contract with Possible Extension
description:
Our Fortune 500 Pharmaceutical client is seeking an experienced Quality Culture Program Lead.


Job Summary:

The Quality Culture Program Lead is responsible for driving the execution and continuous advancement of an enterprise-wide Quality Culture program. This role leads four cross-functional workstreams focused on assessment strategy, action planning, stakeholder engagement, and education, ensuring alignment with the organization's global quality objectives. The ideal candidate is a senior consulting professional who can balance strategic program leadership with hands-on execution, leveraging data-driven insights to strengthen quality behaviors and foster sustainable culture transformation. They should have an understanding of Quality Culture and Cost of Quality, while also being able to manage programs, communicate, and influence.


Key Responsibilities:

  1. Program Leadership & Execution

  • Lead and coordinate four Quality Culture workstreams, ensuring priorities, timelines, and deliverables align with overall program objectives.

  • Translate strategic goals into actionable workplans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Monitor progress, remove barriers, and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Provide hands-on support to develop deliverables and solve operational challenges as needed.

  • Partner across Global Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, HR, Communications, and other cross-functional groups.

  1. Quality Culture Assessment & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the standardization and digitization of Quality Culture assessment methodologies to enable a consistent global approach.

  • Develop and enhance tools to assess Quality Culture maturity and measure program effectiveness.

  • Analyze assessment results to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

  • Develop practical remediation plans and recommend actions to improve Quality Culture across sites.

  • Support the continued evolution of an already established Quality Culture program.

  1. Action Planning & Governance

  • Partner with the Quality Culture Community of Practice (CoP) to standardize site action planning processes.

  • Track implementation progress, ensure follow-through, and promote accountability.

  • Facilitate the sharing of best practices and lessons learned across sites to drive continuous improvement.

  • Create and manage Excel dashboards to support program tracking, reporting, and visibility.

  1. Stakeholder Engagement, Communication & Education

  • Communicate Quality Culture principles, assessment expectations, and improvement strategies to diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Educate leaders and site teams on the relationship between Quality Culture, quality outcomes, and Cost of Quality.

  • Develop and deliver communication materials, learning resources, and awareness initiatives to strengthen Quality Culture adoption.

  1. Global Collaboration & Culture Transformation

  • Collaborate with global quality leaders, site teams, cross-functional partners, and communications teams to drive enterprise-wide adoption.

  • Support global engagement initiatives, including World Quality Day, recognition programs, storytelling, and success-sharing activities.

  • Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, risk-based decision-making, and continuous improvement across the organization.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Quality, Business, Organizational Development, or a related field.

  • Approximately 15 years of relevant professional experience is ideal.

  • Significant experience leading complex, enterprise-wide transformation or consulting initiatives within life sciences, pharmaceutical, medical device, or other highly regulated industries, as long as Quality Culture is a skill.

  • Demonstrated experience in Quality Culture, organizational change, quality management, or continuous improvement programs.

  • Understanding of Quality Culture and Cost of Quality.

  • Strong program and project management skills with experience leading multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority and drive execution across global teams.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting assessment data, identifying trends, and developing actionable improvement plans.

  • Experience creating and managing Excel dashboards.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Power BI is a plus.



Other Details:

Schedule: Full-time

Work Setup: Hybrid (2-3 days onsite per week) in Indianapolis, IN

Travel: None
