title: Senior Consultant - Tax Advisory
description:
Where can a career at KPMG take you? We provide an environment for Connection, Variety and Growth.

Our Mid-Market & Private team supports clients in managing to plan for their continued business success and growth. We decisively deliver new ways of thinking, big-picture perspectives and acute insights that help clients make informed choices to deal with complex issues.

The Tax Advisory team supports clients to look ahead to see how their business decisions can be affected by tax legislation and plan for their continued business success and growth. We work with a range of clients across a range of sectors including large private and listed businesses, high net wealth, family groups, start- ups, early-stage high growth businesses, and Australian subsidiaries of multinational groups

Your Opportunity

As a Senior Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality tax compliance and advisory work across a broad private and mid-market client base. You will work closely with managers, senior team members and Partners to prepare client-ready deliverables and support practical tax outcomes.

You will:

  • Prepare and deliver income tax returns across companies, trusts, private groups and corporate groups
  • Support and deliver income tax-focused advisory work across a range of areas, such as business and group restructures, mergers and acquisitions and international expansion
  • Support ATO reviews and audits through preparation of technical responses and documentation
  • Consider key income tax issues such as capital gains tax rollovers, tax consolidation, tax loss utilisation, Division 7A, thin capitalisation and significant global entity considerations
  • Be involved in the delivery of tax risk management and governance frameworks for businesses and groups
  • Undertake technical tax research and apply legislation, ATO guidance and case law to client scenarios
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and timely delivery of all client work
  • Collaborate with managers and senior leaders to deliver integrated client outcomes

How Are You Extraordinary?

You bring strong communication skills and can confidently simplify complex tax concepts for a range of stakeholders. You are commercially minded, proactive, and passionate about delivering high-quality client outcomes.

You are comfortable preparing client-ready deliverables, contributing to client discussions, presenting to senior leadership, and working on practical tax matters

Your Experience
At KPMG, we believe diversity of thought, background and experience strengthens relationships and delivers meaningful benefits.

To be successful, you will bring:

  • Experience in income tax compliance and advisory within a professional services or corporate environment
  • Experience preparing income tax returns for companies, trusts and individuals
  • Experience delivering tax advisory focused engagements for a broad range of clients
  • Exposure to income tax issues across a broad range of clients, including corporate, international and private client groups
  • Ability to stay up to date with tax legislation, ATO guidance and relevant case law,
  • Strong technical capability across tax compliance and advisory with a hands-on delivery focus
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with a client-centric approach
  • Excellent communicator and willingness to work collaboratively in teams
  • CA / CPA (or equivalent) or currently studying towards qualification

Why Join Us?

  • Exposure to a strong private and mid-market client base and broad technical issues
  • Collaborative and high-performing environment
  • Clear pathway for continued career progression and leadership growth

KPMG is a professional services firm with global outreach and deep sector experience. We work with clients across an array of industries to solve complex challenges, steer change and enable growth.

Our people are what make KPMG the thriving workplace that it is and what sets us apart is that we know great minds think differently. Collaborate with a team of passionate, highly skilled professionals who’ve got your back. You’ll build relationships with unique and diverse colleagues who will provide you with the support you need to be your best and produce meaningful and impactful work in an inclusive, equitable culture.

At KPMG, you’ll take control over how you work. We’re embracing a new way of working in many ways, from offering flexible hours and locations to generous paid parental leave and career breaks. Our people enjoy a variety of exciting perks, including retail discounts, health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and growth opportunities, salary packaging options and more.

Diverse candidates have diverse needs. During your recruitment journey, information will be provided about adjustment requests. If you require additional support before submitting your application, please contact the Talent Attraction Support Team.

      • Exposure to modern ETL/ELT, data modeling, orchestration, transformation, and analytics architectures.

title: Motion Designer
description:
Join a government communications team to produce high-quality motion content across corporate channels: social media reels, explainers, event loops/LED content, internal training videos, campaign assets and app/UX micro-animations. You will create content for internal stakeholders and external audiences (public campaigns, exhibitions and partner activations).

Key responsibilities

  • Produce 2D & 3D motion graphics and short animated explainers (30s–3min) for social, web and large-format displays.

  • Translate technical subjects (desalination, water networks, sustainability projects, infrastructure) into clear, audience-appropriate motion pieces.

  • Create reusable social video templates (Reels, LinkedIn posts, YouTube shorts) aligned with brand guidelines (colour, logo, Arabic/English typography).

  • Localize content into Arabic and English (subtitles, voice-over coordination).

  • Prepare event & exhibition assets (looping videos, sponsor banners, pre-roll content) and coordinate with external vendors/agencies.

  • Maintain a versioned motion asset library (source files, Lottie/JSON for web, final masters).

  • Ensure deliverables meet government accessibility, branding and compliance standards.

  • Manage fast turnaround requests and coordinate post-production (sound mix, color-grading, encoding)



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

  • 3–6+ years motion graphics/animation experience (agency or in-house for corporate/government clients preferred).

  • Degree or diploma in Motion Design, Animation, Graphic Design, Multimedia or similar.

  • Strong showreel (max 3 minutes) showing social campaigns, explainers and event loops.

  • Expert in After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop; experience with Cinema 4D, Blender or other 3D tools for 3D motion work.

  • Experience exporting Lottie/Bodymovin for web and hand-offs with Figma/Adobe XD.

  • Experience handling Arabic motion (RTL typography) is highly desirable.

  • Proficient English; Arabic speaker advantageous.

  • Ability to work on-site and travel to event locations across the Northern Emirates when required.

  • UAE residency or ability to relocate; able to obtain necessary government clearances.

Preferred / nice-to-have

  • Broadcast/video production experience and familiarity with high-resolution LED/video wall specs.

  • Sound design / mixing experience.

  • Prior experience coordinating with communications agencies on integrated campaigns.

title: Consultant Pediatric Cardiologist  - EP
description:
We are currently looking for a Consutlant Pediatric Cardiologist with Electrophysiology experience for one of the reputed Healthcare Facilities in the UAE.

Job Purpose:

To provide specialized cardiac care for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital or acquired heart diseases. The Consultant Pediatric Cardiologist plays a key role in the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of pediatric cardiac conditions using advanced diagnostic tools, non-invasive and invasive procedures, and multidisciplinary care models in accordance within the clinical standards.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate and manage a wide spectrum of pediatric cardiac conditions including congenital heart defects, arrhythmias, cardiomyopathies, and acquired heart diseases (e.g., Kawasaki disease, myocarditis).
Perform and interpret pediatric cardiac diagnostics such as echocardiography (transthoracic, transesophageal, fetal), ECG, Holter monitoring, and exercise stress testing.
Coordinate care and collaborate with pediatric cardiac surgeons, intensivists, neonatologists, and other specialists for surgical planning, preoperative and postoperative care.
Participate in cardiac catheterizations and interventional procedures if credentialed.
Provide expert consultation in pediatric intensive care, neonatal ICU, and emergency settings.
Counsel and support families regarding diagnoses, treatment options, prognosis, and follow-up care.
Document all assessments, procedures, and management plans in the electronic medical record system in accordance with hospital guidelines.
Engage in academic activities including teaching, training, and mentoring residents and junior staff.
Participate in clinical governance activities including morbidity and mortality reviews, case conferences, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with all the hospital and DOH standards for patient safety, clinical documentation, ethics, and infection control.




Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

Basic Medical Degree (MBBS or equivalent) from an accredited medical institution.

Residency in Pediatrics followed by fellowship/subspecialty training in Pediatric Cardiology.

Board Certification in Pediatric Cardiology (e.g., American Board, Arab Board, CCT UK, MRCPCH with Pediatric Cardiology subspecialty, or equivalent).

Valid DOH Consultant License in Pediatric Cardiology or eligibility to obtain it.

Experience:

Minimum 5 years of post-certification experience as a Consultant Pediatric Cardiologist.

Hands-on expertise in pediatric cardiac imaging, diagnostics, and outpatient/inpatient care.

​

WORK LOCATION - AL AIN.

title: Email Design Lead for a US Retention Agency (South America)
description:
Email Design Lead

Remote. Full-time. South America. Paid in USD.

Performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

We are hiring the person who owns email design quality across the agency, and we are hiring in South America because the work runs on US hours and the talent here is better than the market pays for.

This is a player-coach seat. You set the first designs for every new client yourself. You build the visual system they will live in: type, photography treatment, merchandising, campaign worlds. Then you lead the graphic designers who execute against that system, and you hold the bar on everything that leaves the agency.

If you have only ever executed someone else's art direction, or only designed for one brand in-house, this is not the role.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Language

Agency works in English. You will run critique, take briefs, and sit on client calls in English every day. Written English is not enough on its own. If you would not be comfortable pushing back on a US strategist in a live call, this is the wrong seat and we would both find that out in week two.

Hours

You hold 9am to 5pm EST every working day. The rest of your day is yours to shape. São Paulo, Buenos Aires, Montevideo and Santiago are EST plus 1 or 2. Lima and Quito are EST. If you are not willing to protect that window, do not apply.

Requirements

      • You have worked at an agency that services 8-9-figure ecommerce / DTC brands. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
      • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
      • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.
      • You have led designers before. Small team is fine. You know how to brief, redline, and get better work out of other people without sanding it down to safe.
      • Mastery of Figma. Adobe is assumed. You can build for Klaviyo without designing like Klaviyo.
      • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.
      • Fluent professional English, spoken and written. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
      • Based in Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile, Peru or Ecuador, and able to work 9am to 1pm EST.
    • Send a portfolio link with your application. Applications without a book that shows email work go straight to the bottom of the pile. If your email work is under NDA, send the closest editorial or campaign work you can share and say so.

Benefits

PTO

Performance Bonuses

Paid in USD

Fully remote, permanently

title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i Ersnäs
description:
På Inre Kraft arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi på Inre Kraft söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent på ett vikariat med tjg 100 % perioden 1 oktober - 30 November, hos vår kund i Ersnäs. Du arbetar dagtid måndag-fredag.

Arbetstiderna är följande:

  • Kl. 07.30-15.30

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse där vi gärna ser att du kan påbörja introduktion så snart som möjligt.

OM KUNDEN

Kunden är en kvinna i 80-årsåldern med intresse för korsord, hon tycker även om att ibland ta sig ut på promenader. Vår kund behöver din hjälp som assistent i sin vardag då hon har drabbats av stroke.

Arbetsuppgifterna inkluderar:

  • Stöd vid dagliga rutiner, som förekommande hushållssysslor

  • Assistera/hjälp vid personlig hygien, av- och påklädning samt vid måltider

Kunden använder sig av rullstol, lyfthjälpmedel och sond.

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor och en god förmåga att analysera andras behov. Du är lugn, lyhörd och kan ta ett steg tillbaka när det behövs. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Om du känner att detta stämmer in på dig, kan du vara den vi söker!

KRAV

  • Rökfri (kund tål ej rök)

MERITER

  • Erfarenhet som personlig assistent/annan vårderfarenhet

Sysselsättningsgrad: vikariat 100%

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Inre Kraft, kund och anhörig. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

För anställning hos oss på Inre Kraft behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och/eller lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ner på Skatteverkets hemsida. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent behöver du vara minst 18 år.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och de nya regler som träder i kraft den 1 mars 2026.

Jobba hos oss på Inre Kraft AB

Inre Kraft är ett familjärt assistansbolag med huvudsaklig verksamhet i Norrbotten och Västerbotten. Vår målsättning är att tillgodose varje kunds individuella och unika behov av personlig assistans, där det är kunden som berättar hur verksamheten ska bedrivas. Våra ledord är trygghet, stabilitet och familjär känsla. Våra kundservicemedarbetare är tillgängliga över telefon årets alla dagar mellan kl 06.00-22.00. Vi har anordnar återkommande kostnadsfria aktiviteter för våra kunder och för dig som medarbetare. Vi är mån om dig som anställd och våra kunder, och strävar efter att skapa en arbetsplats där alla trivs och utvecklas.

Förmåner för dig som anställd hos Inre Kraft

Som anställd personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal och avtalspension. Du är försäkrad under arbetstid och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag till våra anställda.

Delning av ansökningar inom Team Olivia

För att ge dig bästa möjligheterna att hitta rätt tjänst kan din ansökan komma att delas med våra systerbolag inom Team Olivia, om din profil matchar en ledig tjänst där. Självklart sker detta endast med ditt godkännande, vilket du anger i samband med din ansökan.

För dig med anställningsstöd

Om du har rätt till anställningsstöd tar vi hänsyn till detta vid en eventuell anställning. Att ange denna information i din ansökan är helt frivilligt - alternativt kan du välja att informera oss vid en eventuell intervju. Vi ser detta som en möjlighet att tillsammans skapa en bra lösning för dig som medarbetare.

  • Creativity and ability to delegate responsibilities.

title: Consultant – Pediatric Cardiac Anesthesia
description:
Black Pearl is recruiting on behalf of a well-established healthcare provider in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Deliver consultant anesthetic care for neonates, infants and children undergoing congenital and acquired cardiac procedures. Multiple vacancies may be available. The successful physician will combine excellent clinical judgment with compassionate communication, multidisciplinary teamwork and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.

Key responsibilities

· Provide preoperative assessment, intraoperative anesthesia and immediate postoperative management for pediatric cardiac surgery and catheter-based interventions.

· Manage complex congenital heart disease cases, cardiopulmonary bypass, invasive monitoring, vasoactive therapy and perioperative emergencies.

· Collaborate with congenital cardiac surgeons, cardiologists, perfusionists, intensivists and specialist nursing teams.

· Support cardiac theatre, catheterization laboratory, transport and critical-care pathways within approved privileges.

· Participate in on-call coverage, clinical governance, morbidity and mortality review, simulation and service improvement.

· Provide safe, evidence-based, patient- and family-centered consultant care in accordance with professional standards, hospital policies and approved clinical privileges.

· Supervise junior medical staff, support multidisciplinary decision-making and promote effective communication with patients and families.

· Participate in clinical governance, incident review, quality improvement, credentialing, continuing professional development and departmental education.

· Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and comply with infection prevention, medication safety, privacy and regulatory requirements.



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

Education and specialist qualifications

· Medical degree, recognized Anesthesiology specialty qualification, and formal Pediatric Anesthesia and/or Cardiac Anesthesia fellowship training with documented pediatric cardiac practice.

· The exact specialty and subspecialty award must be recognized under the current UAE Professional Qualification Requirements and support the requested Consultant title.

· Completion of internship and active, unrestricted professional registration/licensure in the current or most recent country of practice.

Experience and licensing

· Tier 1 qualification and DOH Consultant-level experience, with recent high-volume congenital cardiac anesthesia exposure.

· Candidates must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Department of Health – Abu Dhabi Consultant licence for the applicable base specialty/title.

· Applicants must demonstrate recent clinical activity, competence within the advertised scope and no unresolved licensing, credentialing or professional-standing concerns.

· For Tier 1 vacancies, the exact Tier 1 award is mandatory. As a general screening guide, the Consultant route normally requires at least two years after the main specialty award or one year after a recognized subspecialty award, subject to DOH assessment.

Role-specific requirements

· Current BLS, ACLS and PALS.

· A detailed congenital cardiac theatre and bypass case log is required.

· Transesophageal echocardiography certification/competence is strongly preferred.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

Documents required with the application

· Updated, detailed CV showing month/year dates, hospital, country, job title, specialty scope and any career gaps.

· Valid passport copy and recent professional photograph.

· Primary medical degree, internship certificate, main specialty board/certificate and relevant subspecialty fellowship/board.

· Current and previous medical licences/registrations and a recent Good Standing Certificate.

· Employer experience certificates confirming exact dates, title, specialty and full-time clinical service.

· Current BLS/ACLS/PALS and other role-specific certificates, as applicable.

· Procedure/case logbook and current privilege list for surgical, procedural or technology-dependent roles.

· Existing DataFlow/PSV report or UIN and DOH eligibility/licence, if already available.

· Contact details for two or three recent clinical referees, preferably a Department Chair, Medical Director or direct Consultant supervisor.

How to apply

Submit your updated CV and supporting credentials through the Black Pearl website. Please ensure your application clearly states the exact specialty and subspecialty board/fellowship, current licence status, post-qualification experience and present location. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a confidential discussion and document review.

Important: Black Pearl does not charge candidates any recruitment fee. Applications are assessed on qualifications, licensing eligibility, experience and role-related competence. Final appointment is subject to primary-source verification, DOH licensing, facility credentialing, references and pre-employment requirements.

Anställning

Vikariat

Tillträde

Snarast

Rekryterande chef

Jeanette Andrén, jeanette.andren@ica.se tel; 076-6480120

Sista dag för ansökan

2026-09-15. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

ICA ska spegla våra kunder såväl som samhället i stort och är beroende av medarbetare med olika kompetenser. Vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund och värdesätter den kunskap och erfarenhet det medför. ICA värnar om goda arbetsmiljöförhållanden för våra medarbetare. ICA Nära butiksteam söker en erfaren och driven Produktionsledare som vill bli en viktig del av vårt team!

Du blir en del av ett dynamiskt team som arbetar likt en traditionell reklambyrå, där olika kompetenser samverkar i varierande projektkonstellationer. Här arbetar Kundansvariga, Produktionsledare, Graphic Designers, Digitala Marknadsförare och Riktade Marknadsförare tillsammans för att skapa bästa möjliga resultat för våra kunder.

Vi söker dig som är en naturlig ledare och har förmågan att inspirera och motivera andra. Du är lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och har ett öga för detaljer. Du trivs i ett högt tempo, gillar att ha många bollar i luften och är trygg i att driva flera projekt parallellt.

title: Growth Lead
description:

As the Growth Lead, you will be responsible for building and executing strategies that accelerate the company growth. You will define and optimize the user funnel, lead performance marketing initiatives, and implement scalable acquisition and retention strategies. You must be comfortable running data-driven experiments, collaborating with product and engineering teams, and iterating based on key growth metrics.

title: Consultant – Pediatric Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
description:
Black Pearl is recruiting on behalf of a well-established healthcare provider in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Lead comprehensive rehabilitation for children with congenital, neurological, musculoskeletal and acquired functional impairments. The successful physician will combine excellent clinical judgment with compassionate communication, multidisciplinary teamwork and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.

Key responsibilities

· Assess function, mobility, tone, pain, participation and rehabilitation needs in children with complex disability.

· Develop family-centered rehabilitation plans with physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, psychology and orthotics teams.

· Manage cerebral palsy, neurodisability, spasticity, acquired brain/spinal injury and musculoskeletal rehabilitation.

· Perform spasticity interventions, including botulinum toxin treatment, where trained and privileged.

· Lead goal-setting conferences, outcomes measurement, transition planning, equipment prescription and program development.

· Provide safe, evidence-based, patient- and family-centered consultant care in accordance with professional standards, hospital policies and approved clinical privileges.

· Supervise junior medical staff, support multidisciplinary decision-making and promote effective communication with patients and families.

· Participate in clinical governance, incident review, quality improvement, credentialing, continuing professional development and departmental education.

· Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and comply with infection prevention, medication safety, privacy and regulatory requirements.



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

Education and specialist qualifications

· Medical degree, recognized Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation specialty qualification, and accredited Pediatric Rehabilitation fellowship or formal pediatric subspecialty training.

· The exact specialty and subspecialty award must be recognized under the current UAE Professional Qualification Requirements and support the requested Consultant title.

· Completion of internship and active, unrestricted professional registration/licensure in the current or most recent country of practice.

Experience and licensing

· Tier 1 qualification and DOH Consultant-level experience with recent pediatric rehabilitation practice and multidisciplinary leadership.

· Candidates must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Department of Health – Abu Dhabi Consultant licence for the applicable base specialty/title.

· Applicants must demonstrate recent clinical activity, competence within the advertised scope and no unresolved licensing, credentialing or professional-standing concerns.

· For Tier 1 vacancies, the exact Tier 1 award is mandatory. As a general screening guide, the Consultant route normally requires at least two years after the main specialty award or one year after a recognized subspecialty award, subject to DOH assessment.

Role-specific requirements

· Current BLS and PALS.

· Evidence of cerebral palsy, neurodisability and spasticity-management experience.

· Botulinum toxin and other pediatric rehabilitation procedure credentials are desirable.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

Documents required with the application

· Updated, detailed CV showing month/year dates, hospital, country, job title, specialty scope and any career gaps.

· Valid passport copy and recent professional photograph.

· Primary medical degree, internship certificate, main specialty board/certificate and relevant subspecialty fellowship/board.

· Current and previous medical licences/registrations and a recent Good Standing Certificate.

· Employer experience certificates confirming exact dates, title, specialty and full-time clinical service.

· Current BLS/ACLS/PALS and other role-specific certificates, as applicable.

· Procedure/case logbook and current privilege list for surgical, procedural or technology-dependent roles.

· Existing DataFlow/PSV report or UIN and DOH eligibility/licence, if already available.

· Contact details for two or three recent clinical referees, preferably a Department Chair, Medical Director or direct Consultant supervisor.

How to apply

Submit your updated CV and supporting credentials through the Black Pearl website. Please ensure your application clearly states the exact specialty and subspecialty board/fellowship, current licence status, post-qualification experience and present location. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a confidential discussion and document review.

Important: Black Pearl does not charge candidates any recruitment fee. Applications are assessed on qualifications, licensing eligibility, experience and role-related competence. Final appointment is subject to primary-source verification, DOH licensing, facility credentialing, references and pre-employment requirements.

title: IATF Automotive Auditor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a IATF Automotive Auditor based in United States.

This is a remote, travel-intensive opportunity for an experienced automotive quality professional to conduct third-party management system audits.
You will serve as a trusted technical partner to clients, assessing their quality systems against IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and applicable industry requirements.
The role combines independent auditing, client interaction, technical reporting, and leadership across complex assessment programs.
You will help organizations identify nonconformities, strengthen corrective actions, and improve the effectiveness of their quality management systems.
The position also offers opportunities to mentor auditors, contribute to training and technical programs, and support multi-facility client engagements.
Success requires strong judgment, analytical ability, communication skills, and confidence operating in diverse industrial environments.
Extensive travel is expected, typically involving 3–5 overnight stays per week at client sites across the United States and potentially internationally.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and/or participate in third-party assessments of client management systems, primarily against IATF 16949 and ISO 9001, in accordance with accredited certification programs.
  • Serve as the primary client interface before and throughout audit activities, coordinating schedules, expectations, documentation, and assessment requirements.
  • Evaluate quality management systems against applicable standards, customer requirements, industry expectations, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Review client documentation, identify and document evidence of conformity and nonconformity, and prepare comprehensive audit reports and findings.
  • Assess corrective actions and support clients through requirements resulting from surveillance audits and other assessments.
  • Coordinate audit activities with assessment team members, certification coordinators, and other internal stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent delivery.
  • Lead audits independently or serve as a member of an assessment team, including oversight of multi-facility client programs.
  • Present audit results and recommendations to clients and, when required, certification boards or other relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, education, and support to clients, sales teams, and developing auditors on quality management and audit-related topics.
  • Mentor less-experienced auditors through witness audits, technical assistance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to technical writing, program development, internal knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of audit processes.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable operating, safety, ethical, and professional standards while working across varied industrial environments.
  • Travel extensively to client facilities, including overnight and multi-day assignments, with the potential for international travel.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of relevant full-time practical experience, including at least 2 years focused on Quality Assurance and/or Quality Management activities within the past 15 years, preferably in automotive manufacturing or a comparable industry.
    • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949, with demonstrated understanding of automotive quality management principles and practices.
    • Demonstrated knowledge of automotive core tools and the ability to evaluate complex quality systems objectively.
    • Experience or qualification to conduct IATF 16949 third-party audits is strongly preferred.
    • Strong analytical and judgment skills, with the ability to gather, evaluate, and document factual evidence fairly and accurately.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and stakeholders.
    • Strong leadership, organization, time management, and problem-solving capabilities, particularly when managing multiple assignments or working under pressure.
    • Ability to understand complex operations from a broad business and technical perspective.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with assessment teams, clients, and internal stakeholders.
    • Experience with accredited Lead Auditor training, IRCA or RABQSA Assessor certification, CQA, or CQE certification is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with relevant quality, regulatory, compliance, and industry requirements is beneficial.
    • Experience in related industries such as aerospace, telecommunications, rail, industrial/off-road equipment, or comparable manufacturing environments may be considered.
    • Familiarity with international auditing or the ability to travel internationally is a plus.
    • Valid, unrestricted driver's license and ability to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes.
    • Must reside in and be legally authorized to work in the United States.
    • Comfortable with extensive travel, industrial environments, and physical activities associated with facility assessments, including walking for extended periods, climbing stairs/ladders, bending, reaching, and similar activities.
    • Ability to read technical documentation, inspect equipment and facilities, work with computer systems and reports, and communicate effectively in person and in writing.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation based on qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors.
      • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
      • Life and disability insurance.
      • 401(k) plan with company match.
      • Generous paid time off and sick leave.
      • Tuition reimbursement opportunities.
      • Remote work arrangement within the United States, combined with extensive client-site travel.
      • Opportunities for professional growth through technical training, auditor development, and exposure to diverse industries and organizations.
      • Opportunities to mentor developing auditors and expand expertise in quality management systems and certification programs.
      • Work with a global network of quality, assurance, testing, inspection, and certification professionals.

title: Biomarker Scientist - LCMS
description:
The position will support a Neuroscience Biomarks client team that is responsible for LC-MS-based proteomics to identify and quantify biomarkers associated with neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. We are looking for a motivated scientist eager to gain hands-on experience in LC-MS proteomics workflows applied to CSF, plasma, and tissue biomarker studies, and to grow their technical skills in a collaborative, fast-moving research environment. Principal responsibilities will include weekly and monthly lab operations tasks (approximately 70% effort) while additional responsibilities will include routine testing (approximately 30% effort).

Job Responsibilities and Requirements

Lab Operations:

  • Manage lab instruments, consumables, and chemicals/reagents.
  • Manage lab supply and reagent inventory, including aliquoting, ordering, and stocking.
  • Perform sample management, including sorting, storage, and manifest recording in Benchling (ELN).
  • Prepare reagents and solutions for proteomics and biochemistry workflows.
  • Coordinate with the facilities team to manage instrument servicing and preventive maintenance schedules.

Analytical Testing:

  • Perform biochemistry assays, including sample preparation and Western Blotting using human or animal biospecimen.
  • Perform LC-MS support tasks including instrument source cleaning, monthly QC runs, mobile phase and buffer preparation, and sample injection on Thermo Orbitrap and Sciex triple quadrupole platforms.
  • Process and analyze data generated from biochemistry and LC-MS assays. under scientist supervision and contribute to summarizing and reporting findings.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records in the electronic laboratory notebook (ELN).

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Immunology, Neuroscience, or related field with at least 2 years of LCMS experience in the pharmaceutical industry including setup, cleaning, and monthly QC runs.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with biochemistry and molecular biology techniques, including protein sample preparation, Western Blotting, and buffer preparation.
  • Ability to follow and troubleshoot established laboratory protocols independently after training, including identifying and escalating reagent, instrument, or assay issues.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with LC-MS in proteomics workflows.
  • Familiarity with automated liquid handlers, Thermo Orbitrap instruments, or Sciex triple quadrupole platforms.
  • Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

    The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm with overtime as needed. Candidates living within a commutable distance of Boston, MA are encouraged to apply.

    Excellent full-time benefits include:

    • Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
    • Life and disability insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Paid vacation and holidays
    • Eligibility for yearly goal-based bonus & merit-based increases
    • Compensation: $31.00-$41.00 per hour based on education and related experience.

title: Machine Safety Engineer
description:
Eurofins Food & Feed Testing is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to develop practical engineering solutions that eliminate workplace hazards across our laboratory network.

This position focuses on designing, validating, and implementing engineered solutions that enhance employee safety while maintaining (or improving) process quality and operational performance. Working closely with laboratory operations, maintenance teams, quality personnel, and EHS professionals, the Mechanical Engineer will transform identified hazards and operational challenges into scalable engineering controls that can be deployed across multiple laboratories. This role is a cornerstone of Eurofins' commitment to achieving best-in-class OSHA safety performance across our Eurofins Food & Feed Testing network.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving real-world problems through engineering design, prototyping, equipment modification, ergonomics, automation, and process improvement. Success in this role will be measured by the quality, effectiveness, and adoption of engineered solutions that reduce employee exposure to risk while supporting efficient laboratory operations.

  • Design and develop engineering controls that eliminate or reduce workplace hazards.

  • Apply mechanical engineering principles to improve safety, ergonomics, material handling, and equipment operation.

Develop solutions including:

  • Mechanical lifting and handling devices

  • Ergonomic workstation improvements

  • Equipment modifications

  • Custom fixtures and tooling

  • Machine guarding and protective systems

  • Automated handling solutions

  • Process redesigns

  • Specialized laboratory equipment

Develop and Validate Solutions

  • Lead projects from concept through implementation.

  • Create engineering drawings, specifications, and design packages.

  • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions.

  • Perform testing and validation activities to verify performance and effectiveness.

  • Troubleshoot design challenges and refine solutions based on operational feedback.

  • Support installation, startup, and deployment activities.

Drive Enterprise Improvements

  • Evaluate recurring hazards and operational challenges occurring across multiple laboratories.

  • Develop standardized engineering solutions suitable for network-wide deployment.

  • Create implementation guides, engineering standards, and best practices.

  • Partner with operations teams to ensure solutions are practical, maintainable, and effective.

Manage Projects

  • Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and implementation plans.

  • Coordinate activities with equipment suppliers, fabricators, machine shops, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

  • Support capital project development and business case preparation.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously from concept through completion.

  • Other duties as assignd.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related course of study.

  • 5+ years of engineering experience involving equipment design, product development, manufacturing systems, process improvement, automation, or related fields.

  • Demonstrated experience taking projects from concept through implementation.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working with fabrication vendors, machine shops, equipment suppliers, or maintenance organizations.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with CAD software such as SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD, or similar.

  • Experience with prototyping and product development.

  • Experience with ergonomics, human factors engineering, or material handling systems.

  • Experience in laboratory, food manufacturing, pharmaceutical, industrial, or regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with automation, robotics, machine guarding, or industrial equipment.

  • Familiarity with validation activities and change management processes.

As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work!

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering solutions successfully deployed across multiple laboratories.

  • Reduction of employee exposure to high-risk tasks and activities.

  • Development of practical, sustainable controls that improve both safety and operational efficiency.

  • Successful completion of projects on schedule and within budget.

  • Adoption of standardized engineering solutions across the laboratory network.

  • Measurable improvements in employee safety, ergonomics, and workflow performance.

This role offers a unique opportunity to solve meaningful engineering challenges that directly impact hundreds of employees across one of North America’s largest food testing laboratory network.

You will have the opportunity to design equipment, improve processes, develop new technologies, and create practical solutions that make laboratory work safer, easier, and more efficient. If you enjoy building, designing, testing, and implementing real-world solutions, this role offers the chance to see your ideas deployed at scale and make a lasting impact across the organization.

We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, vacation, personal days, and dental and vision options.

Eurofins is a M/F, Disabled, and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Eurofins USA Food Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

title: Livery Artist - Vehicles Team
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Livery Artist - Vehicles Team based in India.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to create highly detailed aircraft liveries for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
You will transform real-world airline branding, custom concepts, and community ideas into authentic digital aircraft designs.
The position combines visual artistry, 3D texturing, technical precision, and a strong understanding of aviation aesthetics.
You will work closely with artists and developers to ensure liveries are visually accurate and technically optimized for the simulator.
Your work will need to remain convincing across different lighting conditions while maintaining strong performance.
Attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to interpret varied visual references will be essential to your success.
This is an excellent opportunity for a mid-level artist to contribute to high-profile aircraft projects while strengthening their professional portfolio.

Accountabilities

  • Design and produce authentic, high-fidelity aircraft liveries based on real-world airline references, branding materials, and photography.
  • Create custom liveries based on internal concepts, community requests, and project requirements.
  • Apply liveries accurately to 3D aircraft models and UV layouts, ensuring decals and base textures are positioned without distortion.
  • Test liveries within Microsoft Flight Simulator to verify visual quality, accuracy, compatibility, and performance.
  • Optimize textures and livery assets to meet simulator standards and maintain efficient in-game performance.
  • Collaborate closely with artists and developers to maintain consistent quality, visual style, and production workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve texture, decal, material, and other livery-related issues within the simulator pipeline.
  • Research and interpret reference materials to accurately reproduce aircraft markings, colors, branding, and visual details.
  • Manage assigned work efficiently and deliver high-quality assets within agreed deadlines.

    • Requirements

    • Professional proficiency with Adobe Photoshop for aircraft texture and livery creation.
    • Experience with Autodesk 3ds Max or Blender, particularly for 3D decal-based livery creation and application.
    • Strong understanding of visual design, composition, texture work, and detail-oriented asset creation.
    • Familiarity with applying and testing textures and decal models on Microsoft Flight Simulator 3D assets.
    • Ability to work accurately from varied references, including airline branding, aircraft photography, logos, and other visual materials.
    • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, polished, and visually consistent work.
    • Ability to troubleshoot texture and asset issues and adapt designs to technical requirements.
    • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of managing deadlines independently in a remote environment.
    • Comfortable collaborating and communicating professionally in English.
    • Preferred: Previous experience creating aircraft liveries for Microsoft Flight Simulator, Prepar3D, X-Plane, or similar flight simulation platforms.
    • Preferred: Familiarity with the MSFS texture system, material setups, and export workflows.
    • Preferred: Experience with Substance Painter or similar texturing software.
    • Preferred: Personal interest or experience in aviation, digital design, aircraft simulation, or related creative fields.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive contractor rates.
      • Opportunity to showcase your work through high-profile, highly detailed aircraft projects.
      • Portfolio-building opportunities within a specialized digital art and simulation environment.
      • Supportive and collaborative creative team culture.
      • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
      • Exposure to professional aircraft livery creation, 3D asset workflows, and simulator-specific production processes.
      • Remote working arrangement.

title: Supplier Engineer, Machining
description:
Primary Function of Position

In this role, you will move surgery forward by putting the highest quality and most innovative products in the hands of our customers to enable better surgical outcomes for patients. The ideal candidate must serve as the commodity owner for CNC machining suppliers, with responsibility for developing supplier capability, supporting DFM during product launches, and driving improvements in cost, capacity, quality, and risk management. This role works closely with design engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure manufacturable designs and scalable, capable supplier processes. Medical device manufacturing experience is preferred. The Supplier Engineer must be capable of making sound decisions when faced with time constraints and ambiguous or incomplete information which is typical in a research and development environment. They will interface with suppliers and manufacturing to build high-quality parts and productize new designs.

Supplier Development & Commodity Ownership

  • Own the CNC machining commodity with accountability for supplier capability, performance, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and execute supplier development roadmaps aligned with cost, capacity, quality, and business objectives.
  • Lead supplier capability assessments and drive improvements in machining processes, controls, and technical maturity.
  • Partner with sourcing on supplier selection, onboarding, dual sourcing, and long-term commodity strategy.
  • Drive supplier performance through scorecards, development plans, and regular technical reviews.

DFM & NPI / Launch / Commodity Expansion Support

  • Lead early supplier involvement and DFM engagement with CNC machining suppliers during NPI and product launches.
  • Work closely with design engineers to influence part design, tolerances, materials, and machining strategies to ensure manufacturability and cost targets.
  • Facilitate supplier feedback into design iterations and document DFM decisions and trade-offs.
  • Support prototype, pilot, and production ramp phases to ensure robust, scalable machining processes.
  • Ensure supplier readiness for launch through process capability, capacity, and risk assessments.

Cost, Capacity & Risk Management

  • Drive supplier cost improvement initiatives including should-cost analysis, value engineering, and productivity enhancements.
  • Evaluate supplier manufacturing capacity, scalability, and constraints; develop capacity expansion and mitigation plans.
  • Identify and manage supplier-related risks (design, process, capacity, regulatory, and continuity of supply).
  • Lead mitigation actions for high-risk suppliers or components in partnership with cross-functional teams.

Project Management & Execution

  • Lead and manage / support supplier-related projects such as supplier transfers, process changes, and capacity expansions.
  • Own project plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables to ensure on-time execution.
  • Communicate status, risks, and recovery plans to stakeholders with data-driven recommendations.

Technical & Quality Support

  • Apply manufacturing core tools to support supplier development and process maturity.
  • Support supplier audits, process validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), and first article inspections (FAI) as part of supplier readiness.
  • Lead structured problem-solving efforts to address supplier process gaps and performance issues.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum: 7 years of relevant industry experience in machining, supplier development engineering, manufacturing engineering, or process engineering.
  • Strong CNC machining and manufacturing experience in a production environment.
  • Proficient in basic blueprint reading and knowledgeable in GD&T.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a supplier commodity or managing a supplier portfolio.
  • Experience supporting DFM with suppliers and design engineers.
  • Strong working knowledge of manufacturing core and qualification process tools.
  • Demonstrated project management, risk management, and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with design engineering, sourcing, quality, program management and operations.
  • Understanding of ISO-based quality systems (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 13485) and their practical application at suppliers.
  • Ability to apply risk-based judgment and make sound technical decisions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Experience with supplier audits and regulatory preferred.
  • Ability to travel to suppliers (domestic and international) as needed: minimum 25%

title: Director of Email Design for DTC Brands (Remote)
description:
Email Art Director

Remote. Full-time. Player-coach.

Performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

Most email at this level is art directed by nobody. A strategist writes a brief, a designer restyles last month's module, and it ships. It converts fine and looks like everything else in the inbox.

You are the art director on every account. You set the world before anyone executes inside it.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them yourself. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Why this seat and not an in-house one

In-house you art direct one brand and get very good at one voice. Here you get four or five live at once across categories that fight each other stylistically, and you get to keep your hands in the file. If you have been at one brand for three years and can feel your range narrowing, that is the reason to read this twice.

Hours

Core overlap is 9am to 5pm EST. LatAm applicants: Mexico City is EST minus 1, Bogotá is EST, Buenos Aires is EST plus 2. US and Canada applicants on PST, you are starting at 6am. Know that before you apply.

Requirements

    • You have art directed for an agency or brand at 9-figure ecommerce scale. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
    • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
    • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.
    • You have led designers before. Small team is fine. You know how to brief, redline, and get better work out of other people without sanding it down to safe.
    • Mastery of Figma. Adobe is assumed. You can build for Klaviyo without designing like Klaviyo.
    • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.
    • Based in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, the United States or Canada.
  • Send a portfolio link. Applications without one are not read.

Benefits

PTO

Performance Bonuses

Paid in USD

Fully remote, permanently

title: Studie- och yrkesvägledare / Administratör
description:
Om Amerikanska Gymnasiet Amerikanska Gymnasiet grundades utifrån en stark pedagogisk idé. Vår ledstjärna är att ”vi arbetar för att våra elever och medarbetare skall nå sin fulla potential”. Vi arbetar därför med både kunskapsutveckling och personlig utveckling. Vår kultur kännetecknas av tydliga spelregler med omtanke. Vi kallar det ”Ramar och Kramar”. Skolverksamheten organiseras så att eleverna förbereds för en internationell arbetsmarknad i en snabbt föränderlig värld, i vår logotype kan man därför läsa “Get ready for the world”.

Allt som sker på skolan utgår från våra fyra grundvärderingar: Courage, Kindness, Knowledge & Curiosity och Grit. I klassrum och i korridor så kännetecknas möten mellan elever och personal av beteenden som härleds från dessa. Vi arbetar elevnära och sätter alltid elevernas bästa i första rummet.

Om Amerikanska Gymnasiet, Halmstad

Skolan ligger inne på Halmstad Högskolas område. Skolan går till hösten in på sitt femte läsår med ca. 160 elever som studerar på Natur-, Ekonomi- eller Samhällsvetenskapliga programmet. Undervisningen bedrivs på både engelska och svenska av ett kompetent lärarlag med en stark gemenskap.

Om tjänsten

Som studie- och yrkesvägledare arbetar du med individuell coachning och vägledning till våra elever. Du hanterar inskrivning av nya elever, följer upp vår skolkö, samt har kontakt med nya elever och vårdnadshavare. Du ansvarar för arbetet kring kontinuerlig uppföljning av elevernas examensprognos i varje årskurs, sköter rapporteringen till CSN, samt hanterar andra arbetsuppgifter som ingår i SYV-uppdraget.

Du arbetar tätt ihop med skolans elevhälsoteam i det främjande och förebyggande arbetet. I EHT ingår skolsköterska, kurator och specialpedagog, samt rektor.

I rollen ingår också löpande skoladministration och arbete i olika administrativa system såsom Meitner, StudyBee och Google Drive. Som studie- och yrkesvägledare arbetar du i första hand från front desk där du har de flesta av dina samtal med eleverna. Du kommer också ha tillgång till ett back office för arbete med vissa administrativa uppgifter.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 100% till juni 2027. Startdatum snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är utbildad studie- och yrkesvägledare, med examen, samt företrädelsevis dig som också har minst ett par års erfarenhet av att arbeta som studie-och yrkesvägledare. Det är också meriterande om du har arbetat med gymnasieelever. Du har erfarenhet av att coacha och vägleda elever, samt också erfarenhet av att arbeta nära elevhälsoteamet. Du förväntas ha god kommunikation på både svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift och du har en stabil digital kompetens.

Du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt i mötet med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare och god insikt om människors olika förutsättningar. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda arbetsrelationer med ett coachande och handledande arbetssätt. Som person är du lösningsorienterad, prestigelös och flexibel. Du ser möjligheter och du leder alltid utmaningar och problem mot lösningar. Du har ett alltigenom positivt förhållningssätt.

Vi söker dig som leder i linje utifrån vår devis “Ramar & Kramar”, som innebär ett tydligt ledarskap och tydliga spelregler i kombination med en stark omsorg om varje elev. Med hjälp av din energi, lyhördhet och uthållighet har du lätt för att engagera och skapa delaktighet mot gemensamt satta mål. Teamwork och transparens är ledord. Du har ett stort engagemang för att jobba för elevernas bästa och vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med ett starkt team av medarbetare. Du delar också vår pedagogiska syn: https://www.amerikanskagymnasiet.se/om-skolan/tankar-om-skola/

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag: 31 augusti 2026.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tillsättning av tjänsten kan ske innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.

Kontaktuppgifter

Elin Fagerberg, HR-ansvarig elin.fagerberg@amerikanskagymnasiet.se

Vi har redan tagit ställning till behovet av rekryteringsstöd i denna process och undanber oss därför kontakt från annonsförsäljare, samt rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag.

title: EHS Technician
description:

Fincantieri Marine Systems North America

Fincantieri Marine Systems North America, Inc. (FMSNA) is a subsidiary of Fincantieri S.p.A. with a mission to build, repair, and sustain maritime vessels that proudly supply, service, and defend our nation and the world. Fincantieri offers rewarding careers to more than 20,000 employees across 4 continents within 20 shipyards. The Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Technician is responsible for supporting occupational safety, environmental compliance, and industrial hygiene activities throughout the Fincantieri Marine Repair shipyard. The position performs inspections, sampling, regulatory compliance activities, training, incident response, and customer support for both commercial and U.S. Navy ship repair operations. Personnel are expected to maintain competency in both safety and environmental disciplines.

  • Support OSHA, EPA, DEP, USCG, NAVSEA inspections, and company EHS requirements through inspections, audits, and regulatory and environmental recordkeeping
  • Other duties and overtime as assigned

title: DWDM / SONET Network Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DWDM / SONET Network Engineer based in the United States.

This role is an opportunity to work at the core of modern optical transport networks, supporting reliable, high-capacity telecommunications infrastructure.
You will manage the provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and migration of DWDM, SONET/SDH, and OTN services across multi-vendor environments.
The position combines hands-on network engineering with detailed circuit auditing, documentation, and end-to-end service validation.
You will work with network management systems and optical transport equipment to maintain performance, resolve issues, and execute complex network changes.
The role also involves supporting upgrades, migrations, and cutovers while minimizing service disruption and operational risk.
Strong technical judgment, precision, and communication will be essential when collaborating with engineering teams during maintenance windows and deployments.
This is a strong fit for an experienced optical transport engineer who enjoys solving complex network challenges in a technically diverse environment.

Accountabilities

  • Configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and manage optical transport equipment, using TL1 and command-line interfaces where applicable.
  • Provision, activate, test, and validate DWDM, SONET/SDH, and OTN services and circuits with a focus on accuracy and service reliability.
  • Operate network management systems to support topology management, performance monitoring, fault management, and circuit administration.
  • Conduct detailed end-to-end audits and tracing of optical services and circuits to verify connectivity, configuration, and operational status.
  • Execute network upgrades, migrations, and cutovers while minimizing downtime and maintaining service continuity.
  • Support circuit provisioning and migration activities across multi-vendor optical transport environments.
  • Create, maintain, and update technical documentation covering circuits, equipment configurations, service changes, and migration plans.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering and operations teams during maintenance windows, deployments, upgrades, and other network activities.
  • Troubleshoot optical transport issues and communicate findings, corrective actions, and operational recommendations clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Apply strong attention to detail and structured processes to ensure network configurations, service records, and operational documentation remain accurate.

    • Requirements

    • 3–10+ years of professional experience working with optical transport technologies, with strong hands-on experience in DWDM, SONET/SDH, and OTN environments.
    • Strong understanding of optical line systems, fiber optics, photonics, and telecommunications transport protocols.
    • Demonstrated experience provisioning, auditing, troubleshooting, and migrating optical circuits and services.
    • Familiarity with TL1, CLI-based network management, and multi-vendor optical network elements.
    • Experience working with NMS platforms for topology, performance, fault, and circuit management.
    • Hands-on experience with optical transport platforms from vendors such as Ciena, Huawei, Nokia, Infinera, Lucent/Alcatel-Lucent, Adva, or Nortel is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with Ciena 6500, RLS, Coredirector, 5430, 5410, Waveserver AI, or Waveserver 5 platforms is preferred.
    • Experience with Huawei OSN 3800 or OSN 6800, Nokia 1830, Infinera DTN or DTNx, Lucent/Alcatel-Lucent OLS, Lambda Unite or TDM10G, Adva FSP 150 or FSP 3000, or Nortel Optera is an advantage.
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across complex optical transport environments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for technical documentation, incident coordination, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Ability to work accurately during maintenance windows, migrations, and time-sensitive network deployments.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

      • Benefits

      • Contract opportunity within the telecommunications and communications technology sector.
      • Remote position available to candidates in the United States.
      • Opportunity to work with sophisticated optical transport technologies and multi-vendor network environments.
      • Exposure to DWDM, SONET/SDH, OTN, NMS platforms, fiber-optic infrastructure, and large-scale network migrations.
      • Opportunity to contribute to complex upgrades, cutovers, and service delivery initiatives.
      • Collaborative environment involving engineering, network operations, and project teams.

  • Perform data profiling and analysis to understand existing data structures, relationships, quality issues, and integration requirements.

  • Define and implement data quality practices, validation processes, and controls to improve the accuracy and reliability of enterprise data.
  • Support reporting and analytics teams by validating datasets and ensuring data structures meet downstream reporting requirements.
  • Contribute to enterprise data governance, information management, security, and cybersecurity practices.

title: Consultant – Pediatric Radiation Oncology
description:
Black Pearl is recruiting on behalf of a well-established healthcare provider in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Lead safe, precise radiotherapy planning and treatment for children and adolescents with cancer as part of an integrated pediatric oncology service. The successful physician will combine excellent clinical judgment with compassionate communication, multidisciplinary teamwork and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.

Key responsibilities

· Evaluate pediatric oncology referrals and develop individualized radiotherapy strategies with the multidisciplinary tumor board.

· Lead simulation, contouring, planning review, image guidance and treatment verification for pediatric patients.

· Coordinate anesthesia/sedation, supportive care and late-effects monitoring with pediatric oncology and other specialties.

· Apply contemporary techniques while minimizing dose to developing organs and long-term toxicity.

· Support radiation safety, peer review, quality assurance, outcomes audit, education and research.

· Provide safe, evidence-based, patient- and family-centered consultant care in accordance with professional standards, hospital policies and approved clinical privileges.

· Supervise junior medical staff, support multidisciplinary decision-making and promote effective communication with patients and families.

· Participate in clinical governance, incident review, quality improvement, credentialing, continuing professional development and departmental education.

· Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and comply with infection prevention, medication safety, privacy and regulatory requirements.



Requirements

To be considered for this role, you need to meet the following criteria:

Education and specialist qualifications

· Medical degree, recognized Radiation Oncology specialty qualification, and formal pediatric radiation oncology training/fellowship or substantial verified pediatric radiotherapy practice.

· The exact specialty and subspecialty award must be recognized under the current UAE Professional Qualification Requirements and support the requested Consultant title.

· Completion of internship and active, unrestricted professional registration/licensure in the current or most recent country of practice.

Experience and licensing

· Tier 1 qualification and DOH Consultant-level post-qualification experience with a current pediatric oncology case mix.

· Candidates must hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Department of Health – Abu Dhabi Consultant licence for the applicable base specialty/title.

· Applicants must demonstrate recent clinical activity, competence within the advertised scope and no unresolved licensing, credentialing or professional-standing concerns.

· For Tier 1 vacancies, the exact Tier 1 award is mandatory. As a general screening guide, the Consultant route normally requires at least two years after the main specialty award or one year after a recognized subspecialty award, subject to DOH assessment.

Role-specific requirements

· Current BLS.

· Pediatric radiotherapy planning/treatment portfolio required.

· Radiation-safety training and UAE/FANR compliance as applicable.

· Experience with advanced conformal techniques, anesthesia-supported treatment and survivorship pathways is desirable.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

Documents required with the application

· Updated, detailed CV showing month/year dates, hospital, country, job title, specialty scope and any career gaps.

· Valid passport copy and recent professional photograph.

· Primary medical degree, internship certificate, main specialty board/certificate and relevant subspecialty fellowship/board.

· Current and previous medical licences/registrations and a recent Good Standing Certificate.

· Employer experience certificates confirming exact dates, title, specialty and full-time clinical service.

· Current BLS/ACLS/PALS and other role-specific certificates, as applicable.

· Procedure/case logbook and current privilege list for surgical, procedural or technology-dependent roles.

· Existing DataFlow/PSV report or UIN and DOH eligibility/licence, if already available.

· Contact details for two or three recent clinical referees, preferably a Department Chair, Medical Director or direct Consultant supervisor.

How to apply

Submit your updated CV and supporting credentials through the Black Pearl website. Please ensure your application clearly states the exact specialty and subspecialty board/fellowship, current licence status, post-qualification experience and present location. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a confidential discussion and document review.

Important: Black Pearl does not charge candidates any recruitment fee. Applications are assessed on qualifications, licensing eligibility, experience and role-related competence. Final appointment is subject to primary-source verification, DOH licensing, facility credentialing, references and pre-employment requirements.

title: Product Readiness & Documentation Coordinator I
description:
HOURS: Eight hour shift M-F within 6:00 am to 6:00 pm MST operating hours.


JOB PURPOSE:

The Product Readiness & Documentation Coordinator 1 (PR & DC-1) ensures that every product release is thoroughly validated and clearly explained before it reaches customers. Using AI-assisted testing and documentation tools, this role bridges the gap between product development and end-user understanding — ensuring product releases function as intended and that customer facing documentation is accurate, complete, and available to support product use.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Product Readiness & Documentation Coordinator works within the assigned product operations structure established by the Vice President overseeing that product unit and is responsible for coordinating quality validation and documentation workflows across the Synergy assigned product unit portfolio.


This role leverages AI-powered tools — including automated testing pipelines and documentation generation agents — to maintain product quality and keep user-facing content accurate and current at every release cycle. The PRDC focuses on coordinating AI-assisted testing and documentation processes rather than software development activities and will direct these tools with product expertise and judgment, reviewing outputs, identifying gaps, and ensuring both quality and documentation meet the organization’s standards.


The PRDC works closely with the assigned Product Unit, Development, QA, CRC, Implementation and Training teams to align release readiness checkpoints with documentation updates.


JOB DUTIES:

  • Coordinate AI-assisted product testing workflows, directing automated test agents to validate features, regression scenarios, and release readiness across the Synergy product suite
  • Maintain and continuously improve documentation libraries, using AI tools to generate, update, and synchronize user guides, ETN and release notes, QRGs, Videos and other help content with each product release
  • Review and quality-check outputs from automated testing and documentation agents, applying product knowledge to identify gaps, inaccuracies, or coverage blind spots that require human judgment
  • Partner with Product Managers and Development leads to understand upcoming releases and translate that knowledge into test coverage priorities and documentation update plans
  • Serve as the readiness checkpoint before releases go live — confirming that both quality validation and user-facing documentation are complete and accurate
  • Maintain organized records of test results, known issues, documentation versions, and release readiness status across all active product initiatives
  • Collaborate with CRC, Implementation, and Training teams to ensure documentation is accessible, accurate, and useful for customers and internal staff
  • Identify opportunities to expand or improve AI-assisted workflows, making enhancements to tooling, process, and coverage as the organization’s AI capabilities evolve
  • Provide regular status updates on release readiness, documentation completion, and open quality issues to the manager and relevant stakeholders
  • Other duties as assigned
