This is an opportunity to lead software implementation projects for mid-market manufacturing and distribution clients across North America.
You will own project schedules, milestones, delivery coordination, and client relationships from initiation through successful handover.
The role combines hands-on project management with cross-border collaboration across U.S. and international delivery teams.
You will identify risks early, manage scope changes, and keep projects aligned with agreed timelines, budgets, and client expectations.
Success requires strong communication, commercial awareness, and the confidence to address difficult issues before they become delivery problems.
As a billable delivery role, you will balance project outcomes with utilization expectations while maintaining a high standard of client service.
The position offers meaningful autonomy, exposure to complex implementations, and the opportunity to influence how projects are delivered across a growing market.

Accountabilities

  • Set up new implementation projects by confirming project sizing and category, establishing baseline plans, and securing the appropriate configuration capacity.
  • Own project schedules and milestones, monitor progress against baseline plans, identify slippage early, and re-plan activities when required.
  • Serve as the primary client contact for project timing, sequencing, deliverables, dependencies, and implementation expectations.
  • Coordinate effectively with international configuration teams, accounting for time-zone differences and ensuring work remains aligned with North American priorities.
  • Manage project scope carefully by documenting, pricing, and routing change requests rather than allowing additional requirements to be absorbed into existing plans.
  • Identify, assess, and escalate project risks early, developing clear mitigation actions to protect delivery timelines and outcomes.
  • Lead projects through completion, ensuring outstanding issues are resolved, documentation is finalized, support teams are briefed, and all requirements are ready for handover.
  • Maintain strong client relationships while holding stakeholders accountable for agreed commitments and deliverables.
  • Manage billable project activity and maintain utilization expectations alongside delivery responsibilities.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience managing software implementation projects for external clients, with ownership of both project schedules and client relationships.
    • Demonstrated experience managing multi-site, phased, or complex software rollouts.
    • Strong client management skills, including the ability to communicate difficult news, enforce commitments, and resolve issues while maintaining productive relationships.

· Advanced obstetric ultrasound credentials and an invasive fetal-procedure log are required where applicable.

Professional capabilities

· Excellent diagnostic, procedural and clinical decision-making skills appropriate to Consultant practice.

· Strong communication and counseling skills with patients, families and multicultural clinical teams.

· Ability to supervise, teach and support physicians and other healthcare professionals.

· Commitment to evidence-based practice, ethical conduct, clinical governance and continuous improvement.

· Ability to work effectively in an acute healthcare environment and participate in on-call services where required.

description:

The role combines automation engineering, test architecture, CI/CD integration, performance testing, and quality leadership.
You will establish testing standards, release gates, test data strategies, and measurable quality metrics across the development lifecycle.
Working closely with engineering leadership and developers, you will influence how teams build, test, troubleshoot, and release software.
The position offers significant autonomy, with the opportunity to introduce scalable tooling, workflows, and AI-assisted QA practices.
Success will mean creating a reliable, automation-first quality culture that reduces risk and enables faster, more confident releases.

Accountabilities

  • Own and establish the end-to-end QA strategy, including the test pyramid, coverage targets, release gates, quality standards, and ownership expectations across web applications built with JavaScript/TypeScript and existing WordPress platforms.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated testing suites, including end-to-end and UI automation with Playwright or a comparable framework, as well as integration and API testing for critical workflows.
  • Integrate automated testing into Git-based CI/CD workflows, including fast pull-request smoke tests, scheduled regression suites, release validation, reporting, and diagnostic artifacts such as screenshots, traces, videos, and logs.
  • Establish a reliable test data and environment strategy covering fixtures, data seeding, mocks versus real services, stable test accounts, parallel execution, and approaches to minimizing test flakiness.
  • Develop performance and load-testing capabilities using tools such as k6, Artillery, or JMeter, establish performance baselines, and collaborate with engineering teams to identify bottlenecks across frontend, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Define and champion a quality-ownership model across engineering teams, coach developers on testable code, and promote collaborative approaches such as QA-buddy practices.
  • Introduce automation-first workflows that reduce manual QA effort, including test triggers, reporting, defect routing, release-readiness signals, and workflow automations using n8n or comparable tools.
  • Conduct targeted exploratory and manual testing when appropriate, particularly for UX validation and edge cases, and provide clear risk assessments and go/no-go recommendations.
  • Establish and monitor meaningful quality metrics, including test pass rates, execution time, flake rates, escaped defects, and regression effectiveness.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and development teams to diagnose failures, improve testability, prioritize high-risk user journeys, and continuously raise quality standards across the software development lifecycle.
  • Deliver foundational QA capabilities within the first 60–90 days, including a documented strategy, stable automated suites, reliable CI diagnostics, a workable test data approach, initial performance baselines, and automation workflows that reduce operational overhead.

    • Requirements

title: Exasol Data Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Exasol Data Engineer based in United States.

This is a senior data engineering opportunity supporting healthcare analytics in a complex, data-intensive environment.
You will design, optimize, and validate high-performance SQL solutions that support clinical, operational, and value-based care initiatives.
The role combines deep SQL engineering with healthcare domain expertise, including claims data, quality measures, and clinical terminology.
You will work with Exasol and other MPP or columnar data platforms to build reliable, scalable, and well-documented data solutions.
The position also involves chart validation, collaboration with clinical and measure subject matter experts, and performance troubleshooting.
You will have significant autonomy and will be expected to diagnose complex data challenges, improve processes, and deliver accurate results with minimal oversight.
This role is well suited to a disciplined, technically strong engineer who understands both the data architecture and the healthcare context behind the numbers.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize complex SQL queries using set-based logic, window functions, and advanced query-tuning techniques within Exasol or comparable MPP and columnar database environments.
  • Extract and stage data from SQL Server sources, including through JDBC-based data loads.
  • Build, maintain, and validate data pipelines that support healthcare analytics, clinical reporting, and operational outcomes.
  • Perform chart validation by reconciling data extracts against medical records for sample patients and coordinating correction cycles with clinical and quality-measure subject matter experts.
  • Apply healthcare terminology knowledge to accurately interpret and engineer data involving LOINC, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm.
  • Support healthcare quality-measure development across eligible populations, denominators, numerators, exclusions, and value sets, including VSAC and NCQA requirements.
  • Leverage Exasol in-database computing capabilities, including Python UDFs, script-language containers, and BucketFS model artifacts.
  • Work with healthcare claims structures such as 837, 835, 834, CMS CCLF, and member-month analytic grain.
  • Support value-based care analytics across MSSP, Medicare Advantage Stars, HEDIS, eCQMs, CQL, and HCC risk adjustment, including CMS-HCC V28.
  • Investigate and resolve SQL performance issues, identifying the underlying causes of slow queries and implementing effective optimization strategies.
  • Maintain disciplined engineering practices through version control, peer review, documented business and technical logic, and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with technical, clinical, and analytics stakeholders to ensure data solutions are accurate, reproducible, well documented, and aligned with project requirements.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of professional SQL data engineering experience, including at least 2 years working with healthcare provider or payer analytics.
    • Deep and demonstrable SQL expertise, including set-based logic, window functions, query optimization, and performance tuning.
    • Experience working with columnar or MPP database platforms and the ability to independently diagnose complex SQL performance problems.
    • Direct Exasol experience is strongly preferred; experience with Snowflake, Redshift, Teradata, Vertica, or similar platforms is highly transferable.
    • Experience extracting and staging data from SQL Server environments, including JDBC-based loads.
    • Hands-on experience with chart validation, including reconciling analytical extracts against medical records and managing correction cycles with clinical SMEs.
    • Working knowledge of healthcare terminology and coding systems, including LOINC, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm.
    • Understanding of healthcare quality-measure structures, including eligible populations, denominators, numerators, exclusions, and value sets.
    • Experience with healthcare claims data such as 837, 835, 834, CMS CCLF, and member-month analytical structures is preferred.
    • Familiarity with value-based care programs, including MSSP, Medicare Advantage Stars, HEDIS, eCQMs, CQL, and HCC risk adjustment using CMS-HCC V28 is preferred.
    • Experience with Exasol in-database compute capabilities, Python UDFs, script-language containers, or BucketFS model artifacts is an advantage.
    • Strong engineering discipline, including version control, peer review, documentation, testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
    • Ability to work independently, prioritize complex technical problems, and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
    • Must be eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation for a senior contract data engineering engagement.
      • Contract expected to run through the end of the year, with potential for extension.
      • Full-time remote work arrangement.
      • Health insurance benefits.
      • Dental insurance benefits.
      • Vision insurance benefits.
      • 401(k) plan.
      • Supportive and collaborative working environment.
      • Opportunity to contribute to complex healthcare analytics and value-based care initiatives.
      • Opportunity to work with advanced data engineering technologies and large-scale healthcare datasets.

title: Työnjohtaja maa- ja pohjarakentamiseen, datakeskushankkeisiin
location: Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, Kuopio, Oulu, fi
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa vastuullista ja kestävää infrastruktuuria?

Mitä ikinä tähän maailmaan rakennetaankin, siihen pitää voida luottaa nyt ja aina. Meille jokainen oman kodin unelma, asiakkaan menestystarina ja kaupungin kokoinen ratkaisu alkaa ihmisistä. Hyvää jälkeä syntyy fiksuista yhteisistä valinnoista, joista tulee parhaalla työllämme ja taidollamme totta. Näin me teemme enemmän kuin rakennamme hyvin. Rakennamme onnistumisen iloa ja arvoa, joka kestää. Hyvin rakennettu huominen tehdään yhdessä.

Etsimme alkaviin uusiin datakeskushankkeisiimme maa- ja pohjarakentamisen työnjohtajaa

Työnjohtajana toimit keskeisessä roolissa datakeskusprojekteissamme. Vastaat työmaan päivittäisjohtamisesta ja tuotannon ohjauksesta sekä työvaiheiden aikataulusta, laadusta ja kustannusseurannasta. Johdat aliurakoitsijoiden toimintaa sekä sovitat työt yhteen työmaapäällikön ja projektiorganisaation kanssa. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä viranomaisten ja asiakkaiden kanssa ja varmistat esimerkilläsi työmaan turvallisen toteutuksen.

Miksi YIT:lle?

Tapamme toimia pohjautuu arvoihimme: arvostus, yhteistyö, luovuus ja intohimo. Ne ohjaavat meitä päivittäisessä työssämme menestymään yhdessä, luomaan uutta ja toimimaan eettisesti, kestävästi ja laadukkaasti. YIT:llä olemme sitoutuneet neljään kulttuurin kulmakiveen: asiakaslähtöinen, korkea suorituskyky, oppiva ja inhimillinen. Ymmärrämme asiakkaidemme tarpeet ja kehitämme liiketoimintaamme yhdessä heidän kanssaan. Asetamme riman korkealle kaikessa mitä teemme, johtaen tiedolla ja esimerkillä. Haluamme jatkuvasti parantaa osaamistamme ja kehittyä. Inhimillisyys näkyy meillä turvallisuudessa, henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnissa ja erinomaisena ihmisten johtamisena.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Rakennusalan insinöörin, rakennusmestarin, teknikon tai muu roolin edellyttämä koulutus tai vastaava tietotaito
  • Kokemusta maa- ja pohjarakentamisen työnjohdosta
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja esihenkilötaidot sekä aktiivinen, ratkaisukeskeinen työote
  • Valmius toimia itsenäisesti mutta yhteistyöhakuisesti
  • Hyvä suomen ja englannin kielen taito (suullinen ja kirjallinen)

Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää sopimusosaamista, johtamistaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sujuvasti eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Työnjohtajan täytyy aktiivisesti pystyä hyödyntämään työssään YIT:n käytössä olevia järjestelmiä, joten riittävät IT- ja digitaidot ovat välttämättömiä.

Lisäksi onnistumista tukevat asiakasymmärrys, analyyttinen ajattelu, tavoitteellisuus ja toimeenpanokyky. Työnjohtajana sinulla tulee olla valmentava työskentelyote sekä kykyä sopeutua muuttuviin tilanteisiin.

Mitä voit odottaa meiltä?

Toimimme vastuullisesti ja kestävästi. Olemme sitoutuneet ympäristöystävällisiin käytäntöihin ja yhteiskuntavastuuseen. Etsimme aktiivisesti tapoja pienentää oman toimintamme ympäristövaikutuksia. Haluamme tarjota turvallisen ja terveellisen työ- ja elinympäristön henkilöstöllemme, yhteistyökumppaneillemme, asiakkaillemme sekä muille sidosryhmillemme.

Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi on meille ensisijaisen tärkeää. Vaikka teemme ahkerasti hommia, pidämme huolta ihmisistämme ja heidän hyvinvoinnistaan. Panostamme työturvallisuuteen ja varmistamme, että työympäristömme on turvallinen kaikille. Tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut työhyvinvoinnin tueksi.

Vaalimme vahvaa yhteisöllisyyden kulttuuria. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ja tuemme toisiamme saavuttaaksemme yhteiset tavoitteet. Meillä on pitkiä työuria ja sitoutunut henkilöstö. Henkilöstökyselyssämme suositteluindeksimme (eNPS) on erinomaisella tasolla.

Rakennamme oppivaa organisaatiota. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa, joissa voit hyödyntää osaamistasi sekä kehittää uusia taitoja ja urapolkuasi haluamaasi suuntaan. Kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia jatkuvaan oppimiseen.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa työpäällikkö Max Kärnä, p. 050 357 7513.

Rakennamme koteja hyvää elämää varten, tiloja, joissa ihmiset ja yritykset voivat menestyä sekä infrastruktuuria, joka varmistaa yhteiskunnan toimivuuden. title: Juniora Revisorsassistenter till Audit & Assurance (Kalmar) – Aug 2027
description:

Du får möjlighet att växa snabbt genom att arbeta med några av Sveriges största och mest välrenommerade företag i olika branscher. Ditt arbete är varierande: du granskar interna kontroller, analyserar finansiella rapporter och hållbarhetsrapporter, och interagerar på ett konsultativt sätt med våra klienter. Du jobbar i en internationell miljö med möjligheter till arbete utomlands, och du har inflytande över din utveckling redan från start.

I samarbete med seniora medarbetare lär du dig förstå revisionsklienters verksamhet, processer och redovisningsmässiga frågeställningar. Du stöttar med att granska interna kontroller och olika poster i resultat- och balansräkningar, vilket hjälper klienterna att utveckla sina processer, sin dokumentation och kontrollmiljö. I rollen kommer du arbeta med en rad olika verktyg för dataanalys, AI och automatisering. I tätt samarbete med klienten och resten av revisionsteamet bidrar du till att öka tillförlitligheten i finansiella och hållbarhetsrapporter.

Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad ekonom och som drivs av att utveckla både dig själv och din omgivning. Du är en lagspelare, men trivs även med att jobba självständigt. Du är strukturerad, utåtriktad, nyfiken och drivs av nya utmaningar.

Vidare ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Goda studieresultat och engagemang vid sidan av studierna.
  • Mycket goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
  • Ett intresse för att utveckla affärer och verksamheter.

Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet (exempelvis inom ekonomi, bank, kundkontakt) är meriterande. Studier inom IT-relaterade ämnen, utöver dina ekonomistudier, samt mycket goda Excel-kunskaper är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk med kollegor världen över som du kan nyttja för att utveckla både dig själv, våra klienter och vår verksamhet. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv och på en revisionsavdelning i framkant av digitaliseringen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.

Ansökan

Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:

  • CV

  • Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.

I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.

På Deloitte värdesätter vi olika kompetenser, perspektiv och erfarenheter, eftersom det skapar bättre möjligheter att effektivt lösa komplexa utmaningar för våra kunder. Vi uppmuntrar dig att söka tjänsten om du tror att dina färdigheter kan bidra till vårt teams framgång.

Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. . För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg, genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.

Frågor

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Helen Nehma, hnehma@deloitte.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

What impact will you make?

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Sjuksköterska/Undersköterska Kardiologi
description:
Om oss

Scandinavian Health Clinic (SHC) är en specialistvårdsklinik inom bland annat kardiologi, neurologi och ortopedisk smärtbehandling. Kliniken är en avdelning inom Scandinavian Gastro Clinic.

SHC arbetar för att ge patienten en helhetsvård, och vi erbjuder allmänmedicin, neurologi, ortopedisk smärtmottagning, kardiologi samt dietistmottagning.

Våra patienter kommer huvudsakligen via sjukförsäkring och privatbetalning men vi tar också emot patienter via avtal med regioner.

Om tjänsten

Som sjuksköterska ansvarar du för förberedelser, assisterar vid undersökningar och övriga åtgärder. Arbetet innefattar även hantering och skötsel av instrument, material och medicinteknisk utrustning samt viss administration. Du kommer att rotera mellan olika arbetsmoment såsom arbete i undersökningsrum, patientomhändertagande, administrativa uppgifter samt receptionsarbete och övriga förekommande arbetsuppgifter, för en varierad och utvecklande arbetsdag.

Tjänsten är tekniskt inriktad och ställer krav på noggrannhet och ett strukturerat arbetssätt. Nu söker vi dig som är serviceinriktad och är mån om att ge ett gott bemötande.

Som sjuksköterska inom kardiologi är du en viktig del av teamet.

Ditt arbete kommer bland annat vara:

  • Självständigt och i team assistera vid kardiologiska undersökningar.
  • Ansvara för patienternas omvårdnad och trygghet under hela vårdprocessen.

Kvalifikationer

Krav

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med behörighet att arbeta inom svensk hälso- och sjukvård. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

För tjänsten krävs arbetslivserfarenhet som sjuksköterska och erfarenhet från kardiologiverksamhet.

Då arbetet sker i nära samarbete med övriga yrkesgrupper är god samarbetsförmåga av stor vikt. Du har ett intresse för medicinteknik, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och är engagerad i ditt uppdrag. Vidare arbetar du noggrant och är flexibel, initiativrik och lösningsorienterad.

Övrigt

Mottagningen har verksamhet dagtid, kvällstid och helger kan förekomma. Tjänsten är dock huvudsakligen förlagd till dagtid.

Vi är en kompetent och engagerad personalgrupp som kontinuerligt arbetar med förbättring och utveckling.

Då vi överväger ansökningar löpande kan tjänsten komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, så skicka in din ansökan snarast.

Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.

Scandinavian Health Clinic AB har inte kollektivavtal men har Personalhandbok som tillämpar kollektivavtalens villkor.

Vi rekryterar löpande.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

title: Legitimerad psykolog till Husläkarna i Margretelund
company: Hälso&Sjukvård, Stockholms län, Husläkarna i Margretelund
description:
Husläkarna i Margretelund, en väletablerad läkarmottagning inom Praktikertjänst med 12 900 listade patienter mitt i Margretelunds Centrum, Åkersberga. Vi är en välfungerande arbetsplats med stabil bemanning med drygt 20 medarbetare som arbetar tillsammans i team. Här sätter vi patienten i fokus och strävar efter att ge bästa möjliga vård. Det är en stark och kompetent personalgrupp med många års erfarenhet av primärvård. Arbetsglädje, samarbete, korta beslutsvägar och ett bra bemötande ligger i fokus. Stor vikt läggs vid hög medicinsk kvalitet och på personalens arbetsmiljö och trivsel. Vi är 7 specialister i allmänmedicin, 2 ST-läkare,1 AT-läkare, 5 sjuksköterskor, 5 distriktssköterskor, 2 undersköterskor, 2 administratörer och en psykolog. Vi har sjuksköterskeledda mottagningar inom diabetes, hypertoni, osteoporos, övervikt, Astma/KOL och en rehabkoordinator.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Fortsätta bygga upp en psykosocialmottagning på vårdcentralen enligt principerna för integrerad beteendehälsa (IBH).
  • Bedöma och behandla vuxna patienter med mild till måttlig psykisk ohälsa inom primärvård.
  • Kartläggning, bedömning av vårdbehov och vårdnivå samt tillämpning av stegvis vård.
  • Rådgivning och kortare behandlingskontakter för behandling av ångest, stress, depression, kris och sömnproblematik, inklusive behandling i grupper.
  • Utbildning och tätt samarbete med läkarna och sjuksköterskor på mottagningen.

Det kommer finnas möjlighet att arbeta en del av arbetstiden på distans om önskemål finns.

Inom Praktikertjänst finns ett regionalt psykosocialt primärvårdsnätverk för utbyte av arbetssätt och kollegialt stöd. Du kommer få regelbunden internhandledning samt handledning av ledningspsykolog på Praktikertjänst.

Kvalifikationer

  • Legitimerad psykolog
  • Kompetens inom KBT
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom primärvård är meriterande
  • Nyfikenhet och vilja att utveckla psykosociala teamets arbetssätt på vårdcentralen
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
  • Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet

Personliga egenskaper

Du har siktet inställt på att arbeta som psykolog på vårdcentral. Du är noggrann, driven, empatisk, har lätt att samarbeta med andra och strävar alltid efter att ge bästa vård i samtliga patientkontakter. Du sprider en positiv stämning omkring dig och vill bidra till en god arbetsmiljö. Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personliga egenskaper samt förutsättningar för att träda in i en roll som psykolog på vårdcentral.

Övrig information

Tjänsten är på heltid, men finns möjlighet för deltid enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar registerkontroll innan beslut om anställning och 6 månaders provanställning. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Praktikertjänst

Praktikertjänst startade för över 65 år sedan och är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare. Vi har 750 mottagningar, från Vittangi i norr till Ystad i söder, som drivs av praktiker som tillsammans äger hela Praktikertjänst. Vi är övertygade om att det skapar engagemang, delaktighet, fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet samt kompetensutveckling - och är en viktig anledning till att vi varje år hamnar i topp vad gäller både nöjda patienter och medarbetare. Hos oss får du en trygg anställning med fina förmåner och goda möjligheter till både personlig och professionell utveckling. Vi vet att våra medarbetares välbefinnande är grunden till nöjda patienter och i det långa loppet, ett mer välmående samhälle.

title: Fabric Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Fabric Solution Architect

Role Summary

A Fabric Solution Architect designs, implements, and governs end-to-end data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric. This role bridges business requirements with technical architecture, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing data platforms leveraging Fabric components such as Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Engineering, Data Science, Real-Time Intelligence, and Power BI.

Key Responsibilities

? Solution Architecture & Design

  • Define end-to-end data architecture using Microsoft Fabric
  • Design Lakehouse architectures (Delta Lake, Medallion layers: Bronze, Silver, Gold)
  • Architect data integration, ingestion, transformation, and serving layers
  • Define architecture patterns for batch, streaming, and real-time data processing

? Platform Implementation

  • Lead implementation of:
    • Fabric Workspaces & governance model
    • Data Pipelines & Dataflows Gen2
    • Notebooks (Spark-based engineering workloads)
    • Data Warehouse & Lakehouse solutions
  • Configure and optimize OneLake data management

? Data Modeling & Analytics

  • Design enterprise-grade semantic models (Power BI datasets)
  • Establish best practices for data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling)
  • Enable self-service BI and governed analytics

? Integration & Ecosystem

  • Integrate Fabric with:
    • Azure services (ADLS, Synapse, Azure SQL, Event Hub, etc.)
    • External data sources (ERP, CRM, APIs)
  • Design hybrid/multi-cloud data integration where required

? Security & Governance

  • Implement data governance, lineage, and cataloging
  • Define role-based access control (RBAC) and data security strategies
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data policies

? Performance Optimization

  • Optimize workloads for:
    • Query performance
    • Cost efficiency (capacity planning)
    • Data storage strategies
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Fabric environments

? Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Business stakeholders
    • Data engineers, analysts, and scientists
    • IT and cloud teams
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship
  • Drive design reviews and architecture governance

Required Skills & Experience

✅ Core Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric / Synapse / Azure Data Platform
  • Expertise in:
    • Data Lakehouse architecture
    • Spark / PySpark
    • SQL & Data Warehousing (MPP systems)
  • Experience with:
    • Data Pipelines / ETL/ELT frameworks
    • Power BI (advanced modeling, DAX)

✅ Cloud & Data Expertise

  • Hands-on experience in Azure ecosystem
  • Knowledge of:
    • Data ingestion tools (ADF, Fabric pipelines)
    • Streaming technologies (Kafka/Event Hub)
    • Delta Lake & parquet formats

✅ Architecture Skills

  • Enterprise data architecture design
  • Data governance frameworks (Purview preferred)
  • Scalable and cost-optimized solution design

✅ Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication
  • Solution-oriented thinking
  • Leadership and mentoring capability

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certifications (highly desirable):
    • DP-600: Fabric Analytics Engineer
    • DP-203: Data Engineering on Azure
    • PL-300: Power BI Data Analyst
  • Experience with AI/ML integration within Fabric
  • Familiarity with DevOps (CI/CD for data platforms)

title: Lead Teradata Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Teradata SQL, UNIX shell scripting, system performance tuning, and advanced database administration. This role requires working with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, secure, and scalable enterprise data solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Teradata data warehouse solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, and window functions.

  • Develop, automate, and maintain ETL workflows and scripts using Teradata utilities (BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPT, FastExport).
  • Build and maintain UNIX shell scripts for automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and manage system workloads using TASM (Teradata Active System Management) and Teradata Viewpoint.
  • Perform Teradata database administration activities including:
    • Backup and recovery management
    • Disaster Recovery (DR) setup and testing
    • User access control and security enforcement
    • System health monitoring and maintenance
  • Troubleshoot performance issues, resolve system problems, and ensure high data quality.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Mentor junior engineers and enforce best practices for Teradata engineering and administration.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience working with Teradata in enterprise-scale environments.
  • Strong expertise in Teradata SQL with complex query design (joins, subqueries, window functions).
  • Proficiency in UNIX shell scripting for automation and system operations.
  • Hands-on experience in indexing, partitioning, and statistics management.
  • Strong knowledge of Teradata utilities (BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPT, FastExport).
  • Experience with TASM and Teradata Viewpoint for workload and system management.
  • In-depth knowledge of database administration: backup, DR systems, user security, and access management.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Teradata Vantage platform.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Exposure to BI/Reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Python or other scripting languages for automation.

title: (Senior) Product Analyst
description:
We are seeking a dynamic Product Analyst or Senior Product Analyst to join the Product Analytics team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

The Product Analytics Team drives product strategy and innovation by providing actionable insights on customers and products, contributing to business success. Our diverse team of data professionals is based in Malaysia, Singapore and Berlin, working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to directly influence product direction. We collaborate with a larger data team, including data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers, to share knowledge and expertise.

You will have the opportunity to access high volume, rich user behaviour data, engage in end to end product development cycles, work on complex product problems, and learn from many experienced data professionals.

Responsibilities:

  • Experimentation: Designing, implementing, and analysing A/B tests with a strong emphasis on statistical methods for robust hypothesis validation and accurate impact measurement. A deep understanding of statistical techniques is required for all our experiment analyses.
  • Product OKRs & Metrics: Defining what 'good' looks like by setting up a product metric framework and quarterly OKRs.
  • Exploratory Analysis: Drawing insights from data to drive product strategy & roadmap.
  • Tracking & QA: Defining which user behaviors need to be tracked and working with engineers on the implementation and QA.
  • ETL & Reporting: Building data pipelines and self-service dashboards.

Find out more about our Data Analytics folks here:

  • Turn insights into impact!
  • Looking for a career in data analytics? This could be the opportunity for you!
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or an equivalent education.
  • At least 4-8 years of working experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics or other relevant data analytics roles.
  • Strong experience in leveraging SQL for analytics (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Experience designing online controlled experiments and analysing results with a solid background in statistics.
  • Experience building self-service analytics dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio (Data Studio) etc.
  • Experience working with large scale user data (transactional, click stream etc.).
  • Background in Statistics, knowledge about statistical test design and analysis preferably hands on experience in designing and running A/B tests at scale.
  • Experience with customer behavior tracking platforms (e.g. Google Analytics, Adobe, Webtrekk, MixPanel, SnowPlow, Piwik, Tealium, Segment etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools or techniques to solve analytics problems, automate analysis, or improve analytical workflows is a plus.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate with stakeholders across various disciplines.
  • A team player that enjoys working with a diverse team and delivering measurable results.

What we offer:

  • A dynamic and challenging work environment.
  • A company committed to developing you personally and professionally.
  • A great working atmosphere with regular company and team events.
  • A vibrant and international team committed to diversity and inclusion.
  • Responsibility from day one in a fast growing and global company.

foodpanda is operated by Delivery Hero Group (“DH Group”) - the world’s leading local delivery platform, operating in 70+ markets across Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Delivery Hero started as a food delivery service in 2011 and now employs 40,000+ people globally. Additionally, Delivery Hero is pioneering quick commerce, the next generation of e-commerce, aiming to bring groceries and household goods to customers in under one hour and often in 20 to 30 minutes. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017.

In July 2024, Delivery Hero SE merged three of its market-leading food delivery businesses, foodora and Yemeksepeti in Europe, and foodpanda in Asia. All three businesses now make up the second-largest organization within the Delivery Hero Group, and leading food and QCommerce delivery in 17 markets in both regions.

title: Member Service Representative I
description:
Primary Function: Able to perform in all Member Service areas of the Credit Union, including but not limited

to: New Accounts, Lending, Reception Desk, and Teller Line


Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. Have broad knowledge of Credit Union services and policies and the ability to answer inquiries of a general nature. Responsible for staying current on all products and services offered by the credit union and be proactive in offering these products and services when applicable.
  2. Accept and process various financial transactions for members and businesses by phone, mail or in person. Transactions to include but not limited to; deposits, withdrawals, loan payments, money orders, certified checks, bond redemption, postage stamps, wire transfers and safe deposit boxes.
  3. Process currency transactions reports (CTR) and recommend suspicious activity reports (SAR) to security officer.
  4. Balance own teller cash, checks and miscellaneous items. Find and recommend corrections in out of balance situations.
  5. Maintain ATM; balance, replenish cash, process deposits. Ensure ATM is stocked with deposit envelopes and receipt paper.
  6. Become and remain a Notary Public.
  7. Have intermediate knowledge to open the following accounts; shares, share draft, sub shares, youth accounts, sole proprietor accounts, certificate accounts (excluding IRA)
  8. Have intermediate knowledge to explain the procedure of the draft account with regards to stop payments, non-sufficient funds for both checks and card transactions, overdraft protection and overdraft privilege.
  9. Have basic knowledge to open business accounts, trust accounts, traditional and Roth IRA.
  10. Have basic knowledge to process distributions, contributions, rollovers and transfers on both traditional and Roth IRA.
  11. Have basic knowledge and ability to explain share insurance.
  12. Process transactions using remote signature.
  13. Assist members with digital banking to include but not limited to; resetting password, unlocking accounts, walking members through the enrollment process.
  14. Have intermediate knowledge to process MasterCard and signature loan applications. Offer and enroll applicants in any voluntary debt protection products available to the loan. Perform credit checks as required and forward completed applications to loan officer for approval. Process adverse and subsequent actions.
  15. Have intermediate knowledge to discuss and process visa debit card disputes, ach disputes, stop pay for checks, teller checks and ACH and receive death claim information.
  16. Have basic knowledge to discuss and process all collateral loans, to include titling paperwork and to process all other types of non-collateral loans.
  17. Have basic knowledge of available commercial loans.
  18. Complete required and recommended educational courses; Follow all rules and regulations as applicable to job function, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act.
  19. All other duties as assigned

title: Director of Food and Beverage
company: The Bentley Luxury Hotel and Suites
description:
Chaz on the Plaza (part of The Raphael Hotel) is looking for a dynamic new F&B Director! The Food & Beverage Director is responsible for assuring attentive, friendly, courteous and efficient service in all F&B operations while monitoring payroll and overhead costs. They are also responsible for continually working towards improving sales revenues to meet or exceed budget. The Director of Food and Beverage is responsible for directing and organizing the activities of the Food and Beverage Department to ensure a consistently high-quality food product while at the same time developing their team and driving a positive work environment to ensure guest satisfaction.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide oversight of the Executive Chef, kitchen staff, serving staff (including AM & PM Supervisors), banquets and operations of the kitchen.
  • Direct outlet management of Chaz Restaurant during high volume periods, including nights and weekends.
  • Responsible for directing and supervising the preparation and service of all hotel food and beverages.
  • Responsible for ensuring the cleanliness, sanitation and safety in all F&B areas while maintaining all records for Marriott audits and local health department reviews.
  • Plans meals and service while directing and guiding the Executive Chef with various assignments i.e. pricing banquets, wine dinners, etc.
  • Approach all encounters with guests and associates with a smile.

title: Data Engineer (ETL ODI) - AMS
description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Data Integration Specialist with over 5 years of experience in designing and developing data solutions using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI). The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and SQL, along with exposure to Python scripting for API-based data ingestion.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain functions and stored procedures using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI).
  • Create and document data warehouse schemas, including fact and dimension tables, based on business requirements.
  • Develop and execute SQL scripts for table creation and collaborate with Database Administrators (DBAs) for deployment.
  • Analyze various data sources to identify relationships and align them with Business Requirements Documentation (BRD).
  • Design and implement Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes to load data from source systems into staging and target environments.
  • Validate and profile data using Structured Query Language (SQL) and other analytical tools to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Apply best practices in data governance, including query optimization, metadata management, and data quality monitoring.
  • Demonstrate strong data modeling skills to support scalable and efficient data architecture.
  • Utilize Python to automate data collection from APIs, enhancing integration workflows and enabling real-time data ingestion.
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues through detailed analysis and root cause identification.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders through strong written, verbal, and analytical skills.
  • Exhibit excellent problem-solving and research capabilities in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

title: Säljare till Kungsängen Karlstad
description:

title: Data Engineer MLE - bilbao
description:
In a few words


Position: Data Engineer MLE

Location: Madrid (Chamberí area).


Want to know more?


INSUD PHARMA operates across the entire pharmaceutical value chain, providing specialized knowledge and experience in scientific research, development, manufacturing, sales, and marketing of a wide range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), finished dosage forms (FDF), and branded pharmaceutical products, adding value to human and animal health.


The activities of INSUD PHARMA are organized into three synergistic business areas: Industrial (Chemo), Branded (Exeltis), and Biotech (mAbxience), with over 9,000 professionals in more than 50 countries, 20 state-of-the-art facilities, 15 specialized R&D centers, 12 commercial offices, and more than 35 pharmaceutical subsidiaries, serving 1,150 customers in 96 countries worldwide. INSUD PHARMA believes in innovation and sustainable development.


Ready to be a #Challenger?


What are we looking for?


We're AI Labs — the applied AI team at Insud Pharma. 30 people. AI Engineers, Data Scientists, DevOps Engineers, Product Managers building the systems that power how trials get designed, how patients get recruited, and how everything gets monitored once the trial is live.


Clinical trials run on data. Bad pipelines, slow models, and infrastructure that breaks under pressure can cost months — or worse, the trial itself.


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer to join our Applied AI Team. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering foundations with hands-on experience in data pipelines and machine learning systems, and enjoys working at the intersection between data, models, and production systems.


As a Data Engineer / MLE at AI Labs, you will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product owners to design, build, deploy, and operate end-to-end data and machine learning solutions across multiple business units — including Regulatory, Clinical Trials, R&D, Pharmacovigilance, and Drug Manufacturing.


This role is critical to ensuring that AI models move reliably from experimentation to production, supported by scalable data pipelines, robust ML infrastructure, and strong engineering standards.


How the team works:


AI Labs operates with a startup mindset within Insud Pharma. The department is young, and the culture reflects that: flat, collaborative, and fast-moving. You will work alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Product Managers who are equally committed to delivering high-quality work.

We hold regular demo days where teams present their work, as well as whiteboard sessions where we tackle problems together. The cross-disciplinary dynamic is genuinely strong. The office is located in central Madrid (Chamberí, near Eloy Gonzalo), well connected and situated in a vibrant part of the city.


The challenge!


  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and serving, supporting both analytics and machine learning use cases.
  • Develop and productionize machine learning pipelines, covering training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Scientists to translate notebooks and prototypes into robust, production-ready ML systems.
  • Implement model deployment patterns (batch, real-time, or hybrid) using APIs, scheduled jobs, or event-driven architectures.
  • Build and maintain feature pipelines and data abstractions that enable reproducible and reliable model behavior.
  • Ensure data quality, versioning, and traceability across datasets and models.
  • Optimize pipelines and ML workloads for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with DevOps and Platform teams to deploy solutions using containerization and CI/CD best practices.
  • Contribute to defining data engineering and MLOps standards across AI Labs. Participate in code reviews, documentation, and mentoring to foster a culture of engineering excellence.


What do you need?


  • Proficient in Spanish and English, written and verbal communication.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including clean code practices, packaging, and modular design.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles (OOP, SOLID, testing, version control).
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines (ETL / ELT) using Python-based frameworks or custom solutions.
  • Experience working with machine learning workflows, including model training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and service-based architectures (FastAPI, Flask, or similar).
  • Strong experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud environments (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with MLOps practices (model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining strategies).
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
  • Experience with data storage systems (SQL / NoSQL databases, data lakes, object storage).
  • Exposure to streaming or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience deploying or operating ML systems in regulated or high-reliability environments.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Interest in applied AI topics such as NLP, LLM-based systems, or scientific computing.


Our benefits!


⏰ Flexible start time from Monday to Friday

Permanent contract.

🥼 Life and accident insurance.

️ Ticket restaurant

Training and language learning platform

♀️ Wellness platform with unlimited free psychologist sessions

🚕 Cabify transportation service for employee use

Development plans, internal mobility policy.

⭐ Many more!


What will the Selection process be like? ️


➡️ Stay tuned to your phone and email! The first thing we will likely do is contact you through one of the two channels.

➡️ Prepare well! We will continue with an in-person/virtual interview depending on availability and what we agree upon; there may be one or two interviews in the process, and depending on the type of process, there may also be some kind of test.

➡️ Wait for the result! We care that you feel guided throughout each selection process and know what to expect from us, so we will always try to inform you of the status of the process.


Do you think this offer is not for you?


Follow us on social media like LinkedIn/Instagram and stay tuned for any offers we may release; the opportunity to be a new Insuder is waiting!
